articleTitle: The strategy of building an innovative product design team
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In the recent several years, innovation spirit has reached top in the list of "the necessary core quality" in almost all kinds of company. The design team has also substituted for individual, becomes the main construction form in product design department. Innovation product design team would certainly become the new work form tendency, both in the common design department and in product design specialty in colleges and universities. This paper sets up for the research related innovation product design team, discussing the characteristic, construction way, organization elements. Through the analysis of the characteristics of innovation product design team, combined with the strategy and the experience in teamwork management, the paper is trying to discuss about the strategies in founding and operating a successful innovation product design team

articleTitle: A new ant colony optimization for the knapsack problem
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The knapsack problem is one of the classical NP-hard problems in operations research. It has been thoroughly studied in the last few decades and several exact algorithms for its solution can be found in the literature. In this paper, we propose a new ant colony optimization (ACO) algorithm for solving the knapsack problem. Comparing with the basic ACO, this improved algorithm combines inner mutation and outer mutation that make it more effective and efficient in solving the knapsack problem. Numerical example is presented to illustrate the model

articleTitle: Skill ontology-based semantic model and its matching algorithm
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Ontology application for employment or HR management is becoming an increasingly important task with the development of semantic Web technologies. With the expanding scale of online-recruitment, such failures as low search efficiency, precision ratio, and recall ratio emerge and become worse. According to the actual state, we propose an intelligent recruitment platform with a skill ontology-based semantic model and its matching algorithm, by which recruitment Web sites can automatically find the most appropriate job-seekers for a certain job post and positions for a job-seeker. This framework of semantic matching can also be applied to some other fields such as computer aided industry design and manufacturing information engineering

articleTitle: An improved facial feature localization method based on ASM
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Active shape model is one of the commonly used-methods for facial feature localization. Regarding the traditional ASM excessively depends on the setting of the initial parameters of the model, a facial feature locating method based on improved ASM was presented. Firstly, we obtain the reconstructive parameters of the new gray image by example-based learning and use them to reconstruct the shape of the new image and compute the initial parameters of the ASM by the reconstructed facial shape. Then reduce the distance error between the model and the target contour by adjusting the parameters of the model. Finally get the model which is matched with the facial feature outline after several iterations. In contrast with the method of facial feature locating by conventional ASM, the improved ASM has higher accuracy and can locate the object feature rapidly

articleTitle: Generating stylistically consistent product form designs using interactive evolutionary parametric shape grammars
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Interactive grammar based design systems (IGBDS) are capable of generating large numbers of alternative designs. Prior to the application of IGBDS, a set of rules should be defined based on the theoretical theories and practical experiences in designing the objects, or by analysing the existing sets of objects. However, due to the time constraints in developing theoretical theories, gaining the practical skills of experts is of qualitative in nature and stylistically inconsistent designs to be analysed, it is difficult to systematically derive a set of shape grammar rules in generating designs which fulfils specific requirements. To address this problem, this paper presents an IGBDS enhanced by evolutionary computing to evolve a set of grammar rules for product form design. In this research, the forms of a product are analysed to derive shape features in the form of shape grammar (SG) rules. The rules are then encoded as the code scripts of a genetic algorithm (GA) representation in order to generate new shape grammar rules. The parameters in GA representation are modified by genetic programming (GP) which is regulated by control planning strategies named "GP-GA-SG". The "GP-GA-SG" control planning strategy first defines ways on how the control variables in GP should modify the variables in GA representation. The "GP-GA-SG" control planning strategy then defines ways on how the control variables in GA should modify the variables in SG representation. The SG rules modified by the GA variables define a new combination of shape features for alternative designs. In this way, traditional shape grammar is extended to an interactive context in which generative and evolutionary computing methods are combined. Both product component design as well as product configuration are supported in this framework. In this paper, we describe how this framework is formulated and discuss its potentials in supporting product design, with initial examples showing how the system is intended to work

articleTitle: Estimating Hurst exponent with wavelet packet
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Applied in many areas, from original hydrology to modern computer networking, Hurst exponent provides us with an indicator that the analyzed data is a completely random process or has underlying trends. But a good estimation of Hurst exponent remains complicated as R/S algorithm shows. Recurring to fractal mathematics, especially the research on fractal Brownian motion (fBm), wavelet packet transform is introduced to estimate Hurst exponent. Compared with wavelet transform and other estimating methods, the wavelet packet algorithm is found able to provide more accurate result. And another advantage of wavelet packet is the extensive choice of available analyzing wavelet filter functions

articleTitle: An innovative function-tree building method based on similarity theory and extension theory
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Product design is a goal-directed problem-solving activity. And function is the basic element for conceptual design which is the most creative activity in the process of product design. In function solving phase, the main method of target function solving is to find the similitude functions, but the similitude functions' searching is depending on the designers' experience. In this paper, the sensuous association methods are classified based on association characteristics. Then by using similarity theory to calculate the similarity degree of function matter-elements, an evaluation system of similarity is set up among the functions which could help the designers to search the best suitable similitude functions for solving the target functions. At last, a method of function-tree's rebuilding was given by adding the similarity functions to the original function-tree. With this method, the solution space of design problems was enlarged, and the designers could get more innovation ideas supporting by more design information

articleTitle: A study on collaborative mechanism for product design in distributed concurrent engineering
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper addresses the product design and realization processes in distributed manufacturing environments. It presents the Web-based integration methodology and framework to support collaborative and concurrent engineering (CE) design. The distributed CE and collaboration are discussed as key components in the collaborative mechanism. In detail, it integrates four functional modules including co-design, Web-based visualization, manufacturing analysis and service module. In realization, Java-based and Internet-enabled technologies can support extended strategies for design and planning. The related system can be used for a design team geographically distributed to organize a collaborative and CE design effectively

articleTitle: An anonymous threshold subliminal channel scheme based on elliptic curves cryptosystem
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Analyses were made on the security threats of present subliminal channel schemes, and an anonymous subliminal channel scheme based on (t, n) threshold cryptosystem was presented. The threshold secret sharing of the scheme enables the subliminal message to be recoverable only by no less than t members of the n receivers. The identity blindness algorithm makes the subliminal message sender indistinguishable with other signers for secrecy protection, and the anonymity can also be revoked conveniently if necessary. The scheme avoids the misuse of subliminal message producing and recovering, prevents coalition attack and generalized signature forgery. Further detailed analyses also justify its brevity, security, high efficiency, and thus considerable improvement on system overheads regarding software and hardware application

articleTitle: Development of an intelligent jig and fixture design system
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The jig and fixture is important basic equipment in the machining process and mechanical assembly. With the development of the CAD/CAPP/CAM and the wide application of CNC technique in the manufacturing, the traditional method for the jig and fixture design has not adapted to the demands of complexity and variety in the practical production with update of products more and more rapid. Computer aided fixture design (CAFD) is an effective way for the situation. The designer's participation and experience are necessary for the traditional CAFD system. A new design system is developed in the article for the special purpose jig and fixture by applying artificial intelligence (AI) technology into the CAFD system, using the theory of the expert system and technology of the 3D modelling. It discusses the configuration, the general function modules, the knowledge representation, the reasoning mechanism and the standard component base of the jig and fixture. This paper explored the technology of intelligence and optimization in the process of the jig and fixture design. Finally, an example of virtual assembly is given designed by the CAFD system

articleTitle: Design of the Smart Home based on embedded system
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Smart home is a house that uses information technology to monitor the environment, control the electric appliance and communicates with the outer world. Smart home is a complex technology, at the same time it is developing. A sample house environment monitor and control system that is one branch of the Smart home is addressed in this paper. The system is based on the embedded system and can act as a security guard of the home. The system can monitor the temperature, humidity, gas density, water immersion of the house and have infrared sensor to guarantees the family security. The system also has network and telephone connection to receive the owner's command and send the alert to the owner. The whole system includes a main control unit and input/output unit. The main chip of the main control unit is the S3C44B0X that is a 16/32 bits RISC processor and based on ARM7 core. In the main control unit, the use of 5 inch LCD and the touch screen provide a well user interface for handlers, the LAN/telephone interface provide the tools to communication. The muC/OS-II software core manages the whole unit work as a whole system. The input unit includes many sensors and its circuit, the information form the input unit is a base of the main control unit. The output is the action part of the main control unit it drives the alert and the switch of the electric appliance

articleTitle: Ergonomics analysis for sitting posture and chair
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: We have to sit when we work, rest or amuse in chair, especially at present most work leave us from heavy labor, and put us in inspecting work, which makes our posture from standing to sitting. It analyzes human's physical structure and pressure in sitting posture, and designs chair in the point of ergonomics

articleTitle: Finite element analysis of high-speed press
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In order to reduce the vibration of high-speed press and enhance its work performance, the dynamic characteristics of its main parts and combined structure were analyzed by finite element analysis software ANSYS. The finite element models of the lathe bed, the base and the workbench were built up. The first five modal frequencies were extracted by free modal analysis. The analysis results showed that the low-order frequencies of the lathe bed were approximate to those of the base, which would cause vibration resonance. The bolt joints were equivalent with the model made of the linear spring-damper element COMBINE 14 between two nodes in ANSYS. The finite element model of the combined structure was built up with 294 elements. The modal frequencies obtained by theoretical modal analysis were basically coincided with those obtained in modal experiment. This proved the rationality of the equivalent model of the bolt joints and the reliability of the modal analysis results of the combined structure. Changing the structure and dimension of the part and component increased the modal frequencies of the lathe bed and the base. This reduced the probability of the vibration resonance

articleTitle: A new compressed voxel-based method for swept volume modeling of drum cutter and its application
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Swept surface model of a drum cutter is established and discretized into uniformly distributed voxel model by ray casting approach. Solid model of the cutter is stored in the form of three mutually perpendicular rays array along X, Y, Z axis, with each ray being originated from the cutter swept surface and offset from its neighboring one at a distance of voxel size, resulting in a compressed dexel model. Boolean operation of the cutter swept surface with workpiece is fulfilled among one-dimensional dexel arrays and workpiece at high speed. Marching cube algorithm is applied to build the triangle mesh model of machined workpiece which can be observed in real time from any direction. This method was applied in five-axis NC simulation system base on compressed voxel model, which has gained excellent effect. The disadvantages of current five-axis NC simulation method and commercial software systems are overcome. The method is the key technology for the virtual numerical control machining

articleTitle: Classification and general kinematic models of 3-DOF planar parallel manipulators
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper presents a new classification for 3-DOF planar parallel manipulators (PPM) with symmetrical configurations and workspace, and the resulted general forms of kinematic model. Under the proposed scheme, 3-DOF PPMs can be classified into two categories. Following this classification, the forward kinematics of category 1 and category 2 are derived and presented in this study, which are featured with a sixth order polynomial and a second order polynomial, respectively. The presented forward kinematic models are ready to be computerized and implemented unlike the classifications and models derived by other researchers requiring much more derivation before they could be implemented

articleTitle: A driving posture prediction method based on driver comfort
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In this study, a driving posture prediction method was proposed based on the feeling of driving comfort. At the first, independent variables and dependent variables were selected. Secondly, fuzzy theory was introduced to depict the driver's feeling of comfort, and then a model was built to assess the relation between design parameters and comfort assessment based on fuzzy SVM. At last, the development of a driver posture is taken as an example in this study

articleTitle: Information framework in product design prophase analysis
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Product design is a systematic project. Only if the designer understand the whole information framework about the design, can the design quality be guaranteed and the creativity be raised. According to the source and target, the information framework can be sorted into 5 parts: culture and custom-design background information, dynamic market-design strategy information, design center-user-creative design information, appearance-design image information, technology project-design realization information. What's more, the information analysis framework can not only help to settle the design black box problem, but also give theoretical support to the intelligence computer aided industrial design

articleTitle: The method of intelligent inspection of product quality based on computer vision
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The technique of automated visual inspection is a new development in computer inspection. It has many advantages such as no touching with inspected objects, high speed, high efficiency and good flexibility, etc. So it has extensive applied foreground in the modern automatic inspection of product quality. This paper introduces the general structure of the computer vision inspection system, expounds the realization method of an on-line crack inspection system of glass bottles, which combines with neural network principle. The system's ability to learn itself and adapt itself is very powerful, it has realized a quick and exact inspection of the on-line glass bottles' crack successfully

articleTitle: HCI in real-time strategy games: a study of principals and guidelines for designing 3D user interface
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The fields HCI and computer games have existed for a few decades with virtually no mutual interaction. However, in recent years, a number of exchanges have appeared both in academia and in practice This paper take the game design concept and HCI as the object of study, based on the cognition theory, summarized the idea of "user experience" and the strategy of human computer interaction, considered the human enjoys the quality, proposed design concept of "bottom-up user experience", proposed for the first time scenario-based user behavior model-GSOME. Eventually we conclude valuable principles and guidelines about screen layout, navigation, selection, feedback and etc, for designing everyday applications, especially 3D user interface

articleTitle: A design of virtual reality based coma stimulation program system
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Coma stimulation program (CSP) is a treatment in which a health care professional or a patient's family member systematically applies stimulation to patients' five senses, for the purpose of increasing patient responsiveness. In this study, we developed a CSP system in which the sensory stimulus was generated by a virtual reality (VR) technique to improve the therapeutic process. The article also pays focus on the effectiveness and obstacles of VR based CSP system

articleTitle: Research of project evaluation and decision method based on gray theory
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The estimation and decision of project is one of the most important content in the project design. This paper aims at the estimation and decision of the mechanic motion project. First, the fuzzy analysis method and its amelioration are analyzed, the lacks of which are also pointed. Then the project evaluation and decision model based on gray theory is put forward. In this model, aiming at the effect measure in gray theory, the evaluation and decision of the project is made. The colony evaluation approach of gray theory is applied in the estimation of the target in the project and it makes the estimation more reasonable. Combining the coefficient colony evaluation approach, an intact project evaluation and decision method is formed. Finally, taking the decision of the sliding bearing and the project evaluation of the rise equipment of derrick as examples, the project evaluation and decision method based on gray theory is explained, and the results account for the scientificity of the method

articleTitle: Summarization of electronic image stabilization
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The common concept of electronic image stabilization techniques is introduced. Representative point matching algorithm is analyzed. Finally, a new representative point matching algorithm applied to stabilize digital image with simple harmonic vibration is presented

articleTitle: The study of the k-ε turbulence model for numerical simulation of centrifugal pump
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: k-ε Turbulence model have been widely used for the numerical simulation of centrifugal pump. It includes the standard k-ε model, the renormalization group (RNG) k-ε model and the Realizable k-ε model. In order to examine their applicability, a series of steady numerical simulations of centrifugal pump at the design point and at eight off-design points were carried out with these three kinds of turbulence models. During the simulations, the influence of the changes on the relative position between the impeller and volute was also considered each simulation. And the impeller/volute interaction was roundly reflected. According to the results obtained, the water head, shaft power and efficiency were calculated and the simulated performance curves of a centrifugal pump were compared with the experimental performance curves. It was confirmed that all these three models were suitable for the numerical simulation of the internal flow inside a centrifugal pump. And especially the result of the numerical simulation from the Realizable k-ε model had a best agreement with the experimental result

articleTitle: Study on supporting theory and technology of product commercial development
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In order to organize the modern R&D enterprises to participate the product commercial development activities, diverse research fields and technology are involved. In this paper, the features of manufacturing enterprises taken part in the enterprises informational plan are analyzed. Then, the method and content about the commercial information expression is proposed. And the detailed analysis is given too. Without the help of the commercial components acquiring mode, the commercial development mode would not be achieved completely. The three acquiring methods are discussed to provide a good way for the implement of the creative product development. In the end, other relative supporting technology is discussed. The research result shows that it is a creative and feasible way to carry out the product commercial development activities

articleTitle: Research on Green design of complex product based on concurrent engineering
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Green design of complex product based on concurrent engineering is a complex systems engineering. It can share the information resources of concurrent engineering and green design, shorten the development period of the products, lower the cost of the products' life cycle and develop the quality of the products which is required by the concurrent engineering and green design. This paper discusses the meaning of green design based on concurrent engineering of complex product, analyses its primary character and researches its key technology: system of product data management, database and knowledge base of green design, collaborative simulation and virtual manufacturing technology and evaluation system of green design

articleTitle: Application of traditional culture symbol in modern product design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to present a new method for modern product design by applying traditional cultural symbol to fit the cultural meanings of new products and complexity of people' life style. Based on the elements of semiotics and Peirce's symbol system theory, the studies analyze the essence of traditional culture symbol and composing of product symbol and show the relationship between culture inheriting and demiurgic design, present a new modern product design method that includes inheriting traditional culture symbol ideals, applying traditional culture symbol forms by imitating symbol, deconstructing symbol and digging principle of symbol and applying traditional culture symbol structures. These design methods not only can bring culture values by transmitting culture, compounding culture and creating culture for products, but also can bring market values by creating new markets and sale points for corporations and society values for people's consuming concepts, life styles and aesthetic ideals

articleTitle: Grey fuzzy decision-making method of complex multi-index scheme based on vague set
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In solving the decision-making problems of complex multi-index evaluating scheme, the traditional way is to adopt fuzzy unified evaluating method. But the traditional fuzzy evaluating method has a lot of shortcomings, e.g. being unable to fully reflect the intended purpose of fuzzy evaluation, because it is difficult for experts to score an evaluating index definitely; sometimes hardly providing a definite dependence-degree for index evaluation; and sometimes causing a considerable amount of information to be "flooded" in the decision-making process when the decision-making system is rather complicated and there are too many factors to be taken into account, thus each getting only a little factor in the distribution, and even leading to failure of the model. Besides, compared with the factor-dependence-degree-based fuzzy evaluating matrix which takes into consideration only the separate influences of every single influencing factor, the complex scheme is a unified whole, in which all influencing factors cooperatively impose their influence on system attributes, i.e. a typical gray information which should be made full use of in the decision-making process. In view of the shortcomings of traditional fuzzy unified evaluating method, i.e. rough evaluation of indexes and negligence of holistic information in the evaluating process, this thesis proposes a vague set-based index-evaluating method. The multi-attribute fuzzy decision, by introducing gray system theory into the scheme, forms a fuzzy decision-making model based on gray relational analysis. The effectiveness of this method is proved with an example

articleTitle: Research and implementation of reversible logic synthesis algorithmin digital system
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The reversible logic synthesis is one of the important methods in the digital system's fault testing and investigating area. As the designing and manufacturing technique of vary large scale digital systems fast develops, under current computer conditions, how to rapidly and accurately implement the reversible logic synthesis of a vary large scale digital systems is a knotty problem that the computer aided logic design researchers have been difficult to resolve and can not evade. Based on deeply studying logical synthesis theories, this paper presented an algorithm called iterative intersection of subset, improved reversible logic synthesis algorithm, and made efficiency experiments of the algorithm. The outcome showed that the reversible logic synthesis performance of vary large scale digital systems using iterative intersection algorithm is markedly superior to the traditional logical synthesis algorithm

articleTitle: Digital technology and digital product design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: It goes without saying that the means of designing product is changing following the appearance of the times of information, and the digital design with deep modern features has become the main tool of industrial product design. In the paper, severe of digital technologies which have been paid attention to by domestic and oversea scholars are introduced particularly, including reverse engineering (RE), rapid prototyping (RP), virtual reality (VR), tactile design (TD) and digital product model. At same time, digital technology applied in industrial product design is discussed

articleTitle: Resource perspectives in the context of process management of product development
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Resource perspectives play a key role in product development process management. Until recently the major share of the attention of product development researcher has stayed at process perspectives. This paper presents a complete resource concept model and a comprehensive resource meta-model as well as resource allocation policies for product development project. We define the above two models in UML class diagram. The resource concept model integrates resource type and resource entity in a complete resource structure. The resource meta-model allows for the specification of resource types (such as organizational position, role, et al.), authority, product development team and resource entity. Additional feature of resource meta-model is the tight integration of organizational structure, role structure and resource entity. At last we develop some resource allocation polices for the planning phase and the implementation phase of product development project. The policies can be used as a comprehensive macro-resolution for resource allocation according to product development properties. An important goal of this work is to support development of product development management system according to our models and resource allocation policies

articleTitle: Frequency sampling based FIR digital filter design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, an optimization design method of FIR digital filter based on frequency sampling technique with introduction of particle swarm optimization (PSO) is proposed. The rate of the passband ripple to the stopband attenuation is regarded as optimization goal, through optimized the interpolation of transition on band and the algorithm is designed by global optimized capability of PSO. Experimental results have shown that the design is both feasible and effective, and its performance is better than that of traditional methods

articleTitle: Green air-conditioner design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Over one century since air-conditioner was invented, people have been using the traditional means of air-conditioning. With the industrialization of human society and improvement of living quality, air-conditioner has been widely used in people's life but at the same time, created a series of problems, for example, waste of energy, air-condition symptoms, damage of ozone layer, etc. Nowadays, people have been paying more and more attention to sustainable development. Development of air-conditioner is facing a series of challenges, e.g. energy saving and utilization, quality and comfort level of indoor air, introduction of green standards medium, environmental protection, and cost and function of air-conditioner. Research has been focused on high-efficiency, energy-saving, and environmental friendly air-conditioning worldwide. This article discusses the design process of a whole-new green air-conditioner with emphasis on the above issues

articleTitle: Nonlinear finite element buckling analysis of rectangular reinforced concrete long columns confined with carbon fiber reinforced plastic sheets under small eccentric compression
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Owing to some problems in their stability of existent building structures, the general software ANSYS is adopted to establish the finite element solid models of rectangular reinforced concrete long columns confined with CFRP sheets under eccentric compression and used to analyze the influence of CFRP sheets to these structural buckling loads. Height of columns, layers of CFRP sheets, concrete grade, longitudinal rebar diameter, stirrup diameter, stirrup spacing and eccentric distance are some factors considered. Based on the nonlinear finite element buckling analysis of these columns, some major conclusions are summarized as follows: (1) The enhanced level of buckling load is descending with the increasing columns' height and increasing with the increasing layers and eccentric distance; (2) The buckling load increment is independent of concrete grade, longitudinal rebar diameter, stirrup diameter and stirrup spacing; (3) The improvement is comparatively obvious to use CFRP sheets to strengthen the structure when its stability is poor. Influences of CFRP sheets to rectangular reinforced concrete long columns can be found by analyzing the stability of these columns, and the analysis results are available for the strengthening of some concrete structures in practice

articleTitle: The research on accuracy optimization of beam search algorithm
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Heuristic hill-climbing search algorithm can do effectively pruning. In practice, it can be used to search a large hypothesis space to get an optimal or an approximate optimal solution. Beam search algorithm retains its advantage in efficiency while reducing the risk of converging to locally optimal hypotheses. Beam search algorithm is widely used in AI field. To k-size beam search, due to only k paths is maintained the key to optimize the accuracy of beam search is how to select the k paths. In most of search algorithms, the k candidates with the most high performance measure value are selected at each search step. In this paper, the author presented some methods of candidate selection of beam search approaches, and the thought of avoiding "full of blood brother nodes" is presented. The experiments were done on the UCI repository of machine learning databases

articleTitle: Image encryption algorithm based on chaotic system
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Traditional permutation encryption algorithm is not robustness for noise disturbing and shear transformation attacks. In order to ameliorate the security of image encryption algorithm, we present an image encryption algorithm based on location transformation. The algorithm permute image based on chaotic system and storage everyone pixel of the image in multi-place, this encrypted image is robustness for noise disturbing and shear transformation attack. An extended magic square matrix-generating algorithm is also presented and it improves on the efficiency of the magic square matrix-generating algorithm. The simulation results show that the effect of decrypting image is good when the encrypting image is modified by noise disturbing and shear transformation attack

articleTitle: A knowledge management model for product design process
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: A tremendous amount of useful information is generated during the process of designing, but often only the final result is recorded. To effectively manage knowledge can help engineers rapidly redesign another similar product by modifying the original design process. This article brings forward a model to manage knowledge generated from the design process. This model supports the reuse of these design process knowledge through mapping the product composition and variation relation in practical product design to the product design process knowledge in effect. This article also gives an example of product design to validate the model

articleTitle: Research on users' tacit knowledge representation based on image scale
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: To study the representation of users' tacit knowledge, a novel approach of image scale was proposed. From industrial design, the users' tacit knowledge and design knowledge were explored. The transforming model of tacit knowledge to explicit knowledge was put forward. Taken the glasses form design as an example, protocol analysis and semantic differential method etc. were adopted to analyze the acquisition and representation of users' tacit knowledge and design knowledge, manifest the tacit knowledge and test the model so as to improve the computer-aided glass design system

articleTitle: A new evolutionary algorithm for the shortest path planning on curved surface
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Finding the shortest path between two given points over a curved surface is very important both in theoretically and practically. This article introduces the frame of genetic algorithm and with the help of the biological theory of DNA technology, it simulates double helix structure and utilizes molecular satisfying the Watson-Crick complementary condition to code and operate. DNA-GA inherited global search capability, enhanced the validity and the speed of convergence, and avoided the premature and lower convergent speed of the classic genetic algorithm, It fits for solving the problem of finding the shortest path on a curved surface. A numerical simulation example was presented at the end of the paper in order to testify the effectiveness and validity

articleTitle: An analytical method based on design structure matrix for modular identification
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper presents an algorithm of modular identification in product architecture design on the base of information dependency. A design structure matrix (DSM) model is constructed to capture the relationship between members, and it can be transformed for searching better product structure. A coordination cost function is defined to evaluate modular quality. If the cost of every module is same, it is impossible to find out better modules, consequently, an auxiliary estimated function is also proposed. It avoids the limitation of coordination cost function and would be capable of accurately selecting available module. A detail of calculation steps are described and a testing case illustrates the effect of the algorithm. The results also show that the optimal modular partition can be obtained. The method may be applied in product design management for clustering components to prompt quality of product, for ordering design parameters and for building a development team to speed up development process

articleTitle: Physical ergonomics analysis for power hand drill
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Power hand drill is a representative hand tool product. All human factors considerations for hand tools design can be applied into the design of power hand drill. The physical ergonomics relates closely to severe healthy and safety problems caused by using improper designed hand tools. This paper puts forward the principles for hand tools design, and analyzes thoroughly the physical ergonomics from four aspects that are the anthropometry, biomechanics, functional anatomy and physiology. The overall goal is to optimize the relationship between users and the hand tools, to design hand tools safer to use and to design hand tools to improve user's using performance

articleTitle: Computer-aided analysis of a 3-DoF parallel mechanismwith two translations and one rotation
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: A type of 3-DoF parallel mechanism with two translational DoFs and one rotational DoF around the axis parallel to the translational plane is analyzed thoroughly in this paper. The kinematic solutions and singularities of this parallel mechanism are analyzed in detail and closed-form kinematic solutions for both direct and inverse are given. Some pertaining topics are also investigated, including the condition number and the workspace analysis

articleTitle: An interactive color harmony design system based on color vision law
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Following color vision law is a good method for color harmony design. But there are two questions in dire need of resolve. First, the color models such as L*a*b*, RGB and HSV in actual CAD system are not uniform in vision; second there are short of harmony control techniques. In this article, a visual perceptual color model, i.e. HVC model is established based on artificial neural network (ANN). The ANN training data come from the Munsell system and Chinese color system. And the comparison between the HVC model and the L*a*b* model in Photoshop software is presented. Then, a set of harmony control algorithms are discussed in detail. Lastly, an interactive color harmony design system (ICHDS) is developed based on the HVC model and the harmony algorithms. Application testified that ICHDS provides effective color harmony design tools

articleTitle: Customization oriented heuristic user interface design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: To improve the development quality of user interface (UI) to meet users' requirements, the customization UI becomes necessary. In this paper, a heuristic customization scenario for UI is proposed to obtain users' intention effectively. The HUID is achieved through two customizations - the manual customization duration UI design and the automatic customization duration UI usage. In manual customization, the UI pattern is redefined in order to control its' parameters conveniently, which meet user needs for customization as soon as possible. In automatic customization, user interface knowledge base (UIKD) that stores users' preferences is introduced to increase the ability of automatic adjustment interface. Moreover, the detailed design steps and case study for UI are implemented, which enhances the reusability of UI knowledge and adaptation of UI. Finally, the conclusion and further work are indicated

articleTitle: Product conceptual design and innovation engineering research present situation and development direction
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Conceptual design is regarded as an important stage of product design. The conceptual design has decisive influence on the product design. Based on analyzing the concept and general process of conceptual design, the key technologies including design process modeling, concept information representation, design scheme generation, design scheme selection and prototype system development, are presented. The state-of the-art of these technologies is comprehensively investigated and the comparisons of advantages and disadvantages between the various approaches involved in these technologies are provide. The paper has analysed five respects of product innovation in conceptual design especially. The current problems in conceptual design are summarized. Finally, the development directions of conceptual design are discussed and the avenues of future exploration are indemnified

articleTitle: A practical method for evaluating capability of scene matching algorithms
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Evaluating the capability of matching algorithms for actual engineering application of scene matching navigation system can promote the research in point. A doable capability evaluation method based on database has been proposed in this paper through computer-aided simulation studies. Firstly, a systemic project programming is designed with four parts: database administering, couple images creating, matching experiments simulating and experimental data analyzing, which contained the most important key techniques in the item. With this understanding, the material course of capability evaluation is advanced in detail. Then, each necessary technique of the proposed method is introduced particularly, i.e. matching capability indices definition, image character parameters calculation, couple images creation and experimental data analysis. Finally, simulative experiments are carried out to show the advantages of the proposed approach. Results show that the method has valid ability in confirmation of theoretical studies, and drawing scientific remarks on matching algorithms adaptability. Above all, it has applied value in engineering application of scene matching technique, as well as in assistant decision-making of real-time positioning of aircraft

articleTitle: Parametric design of mannequins for virtual try-on system
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper presents an approach for parametric design of human models, which can be used in virtual try-on system, games or other virtual reality (VR) environment. Consumers are assisted in automatically generating a virtual model through modifying the standard one by controlling the measurement parameters. Our approach consists of four major parts. First, 3D scanner data is preprocessed and provides basic body parameters to standard body models. Second, the system builds a series of standard body models combined the previous parameters and commercial software Poser. Third, measures individual body. Finally, modeling synthesis is accomplished by standard body models and the individual parameters using degree 3 NURBS curves. In comparison with other similar systems, our methodology is efficient and accurate, and adapt to be used in virtual try-on system on Internet

articleTitle: Ansys second development method and application in computer aided engineering
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The computer aided engineering (CAE) is aiming at the numerical simulation-the important link in the advanced digital manufacturing. Its second development based on ANSYS platform can be carried out often. In common, the Visual Basic and APDL are important development tools and are applied in the product design at the same time. In the paper, the secondary development flow and method based on ANSYS is described. The parameter design and analysis process of the bridge girder erecting equipment is carried on with ANSYS software and its secondary development tools-APDL and Visual Basics, including the interact between the mode of ANSYS batch solving and Visual Basic. The method speeds up design and enhances the product the quality and the performance

articleTitle: Study onwebparts-based complex product commercial design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The product commercial development mode will make an important impact on the creative product development style. In this paper, the basis of the product commercial development that is the Webparts data integrated model is proposed first. In this data model, three important parts such as the data mining, the data processing and the data expressing are analyzed. Then, the Internet-based Webparts application system is set up. And the components searching engine playing an important role in system is discussed. At last, the agent-based Webparts search engine is studied. And with the help of the searching engine, the optimized commercial result will be achieved

articleTitle: Smart sport underwear design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This smart sport underwear, where sensors, electrodes, and bus structure are all integrated in the textile material, make it possible to monitor the physiology status of the user. By providing direct feedback to the users, they can act on the level of awareness and allow better control of their own conditions

articleTitle: Finite element analysis for magnetic field of giant magnetostrictive actuator
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: An axial symmetry model of giant magnetostrictive actuator was built in this paper. Based on it, the magnetic field of the actuator was analyzed with finite element method, and the extension of giant magnetostrictive rod was calculated under different excitative current with numerical integration. According to comparison between the experimental results and modeling results, it can be obviously seen that the linear working domain of the actuator is estimated effectively

articleTitle: Music features recognition and its application in national music protection
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Music features recognition is an important research hotspot in computer music, which can be widely applied in many fields such as multimedia retrieval, human-machine interaction, digital heritage, digital entertainment and so on. Aimed at digital heritage protecting engineering of Chinese national music, this thesis discusses the topic of music features recognition technology by simulating human's cognitive process based on MIDI files, mainly including such high-level features recognition technologies as melody extraction, music section recognition and partition, and emotion recognition. At last, the prototype system of virtual editor and exhibition for Chinese national music by means of aforementioned technologies are developed to serve for digital popularising of Chinese national music

articleTitle: Vehicle design research for Chinese elderly drivers
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: China has a very large population base on which aging occur. On the other hand, China has one of the fastest-growing fleets of automobiles in the world. The number of private car older users is increasing dramatically in Chinese urban areas. This demonstrates that the Chinese vehicle market needs design research and innovation for local older drivers. However, through literature review, this paper shows that few research studies on Chinese drivers are available in either international or Chinese journals. Moreover, in the design research community, there are limited data to direct designers and the automobile industry in the effective design and integration of new technologies, especially for older drivers. This paper concentrates on introducing research background knowledge in order to identify the future research gap. The research proposal has been present as well

articleTitle: Conceptual engineering design organization in collaborative teams of two university - company agreement
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper deals with the different kinds and organization of conceptual engineering design for product innovation, attending the different parameters: objectives, specification framework and kind of interaction between two collaborative teams company and university collaborative teams in agreements. Is proposed from two different experience cases, to analyze these parameters to anticipate for a new one case the amount of creativity task needed and the particular job organization for this conceptual design

articleTitle: Awareness ontology model in the collaborative learning environment
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In order to organise the awareness information in the collaborative learning environment reasonably and efficiently, making good use of the ontology characteristics such as clear knowledge organization, explicit definition of concept and relation etc, an awareness ontology model is presented in this paper. The model contains six aspects: person, community, role, KnowledgeDomain, event and activity as well as each kind of relations among these concepts and in the concept interior. This model can solve the existing flaws like chaotic organization and difficult maintenance in the traditional mode of awareness information organization. Thus enhances collaborative learning efficiency in the greatest degree. For constructing needed ontology reasonably and conveniently, a method of KnowledgeDomain correlativity extraction based on the N-Grams is presented on the basis of awareness ontology model. It can extract the asrelativity? relation automatically and satisfy dynamic awareness processing

articleTitle: Hierarchical access control for secure group communication
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Access control is a fundamental concern in any system that manages resource. In particular, the dynamical distributed access control problem is very difficult and does not have easy solutions. In this paper, we provide solutions by limiting the problem's domain and propose a simple, yet efficient dynamic hierarchical access control schemes: a Chinese Remainder Theorem based hierarchical access scheme for secure group communications. We also propose an improved scheme for recent attacks

articleTitle: Product adaptive design based on extension co-transforming: a differential approach
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The concept of adaptable design (AD) immensely influences the suitability of a product life-cycle (PLC).The product with more variety, versatility, customization and update will become abstractive and competitive. For the purpose to meet the adaptability, a new extension adaptive design approach (EAD) was carried out by design theory and artificial intelligence research. The modeling methodology based on design basic element (X-J) which is different from the current UML modeling. Through the function extension analysis, the structure would possessed more adaptability in the design process. Finally, example from a CPM (continuous passive motion) machine design will illustrate the applicability and implementation of selected principles in the area of computer aided product design

articleTitle: Research on e-learning system model based on affective computing
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Aiming at emotion deficiency in present e-learning system, a lot of negative effects were analyzed and corresponding countermeasures were proposed. Basing on it, we combined affective computing with the traditional e-learning system. The model of e-learning system based on affective computing was constructed by using facial expression recognition, emotion recognition of speech and motion recognition techniques. The key techniques of realizing the system were also introduced

articleTitle: Intelligent virtual team in collaborative design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: A group of organizationally or geographically dispersed workers brought together to work on a common project through communication and information technologies is a virtual team. Organizations assemble and support them for a variety of activities, such as new product development, knowledge sharing, and so on. The advantages of such teams are obvious: people no longer must work in the same physical location to work "together"; participants can contribute from any location, at any time. By breaking down the barriers of space and time, a virtual team fully utilizes the expertise of the members of an organization-or of several organizations-without pulling them from other projects or incurring relocation expenses. Hence, at least notionally, such teams have immense potential for improving organizational effectiveness

articleTitle: Computer aided design and manufacturing of the framework of PFM fixed bridge
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper we develop an original dental CAD/CAM system for design and manufacture the framework of PFM (porcelain fused to metal) fixed bridge in computer. Take example for the missing of the mandibular first molar, firstly, we use ATOS II 3D scanner to measure the 3D data of the abutment teeth which is used to design the coping crowns. Secondly, a relevant standard bridge is selected from the standard bridges database and deformed based on the characteristic of the patient. Then it's set to the correct position between the coping crowns automatically based on the constraint lines and faces. Finally, two connectors are designed to connect the coping crowns and the bridge based on the cutting area. The final product is milled by a 4-axis NC milling machine. After examined, the framework of PFM fixed bridge fits the abutment teeth very well. The intensity of the connectors and the precision of the whole model all tally with clinically demand. According to the final result, the method of design and manufacturing the framework of PFM fixed bridge using CAD/CAM technology is feasible, efficient and precise. It is also an important part of the homemade dental CAD/CAM system

articleTitle: Efficient flooding in peer-to-peer networks
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Peer-to-peer (P2P) computing has emerged as a popular model aiming at further utilizing Internet information and resources. Flooding is the basic method of searching in unstructured P2P networks however the blind flooding based search mechanism causes a large volume of unnecessary traffic, and greatly limits the performance of P2P systems. Our study shows that a large amount of unwanted traffic is divinable and can be avoided while searching in P2P networks. Aiming at reducing the volume of unnecessary traffic, an unnecessary message prediction based searching mechanism (UMPS) is proposed. UMPS is a pure distributed scheme, it is based on the distributed neighbor list where neighbors within two hops are stored in. UMPS cuts down unwanted traffic by terminating unnecessary flooding that has been predicted in advance, and the techniques related to distributed neighbor list are also discussed. Simulation results show that more than 60% unnecessary messages can be reduced by UMPS, and the query coverage range is retained at the same time, and more unwanted messages can be reduced if a peer has larger degree, therefore load balancing is achieved also. Simulations also reveal that the effectiveness of UMPS is positive correlation with clustering coefficient of network

articleTitle: Studies for the product innovative design system based on TRIZ
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: It is more important for increasing competitiveness of product to introduce computer-aided design based on high-level innovative design. In the leading of creative thinking, this paper provides an innovative conceptual design process model, which is a concentration of design method including theory of TRIZ, Brain Storming and conquering thinking inertia, as a methodology device. The original system of product innovative design based on TRIZ, which combines old model that cooperated in different areas, is composed with four conceptual design subsystems based on TRIZ and so on. The system, not only can cooperate innovative design, but also can provide more services of conceptual design resource to remote users, possessing of depth knowledge resource unit. Moreover, the system also has more characteristic, such as urging, leading and helping designer to engage innovative design

articleTitle: Ergonomic experiment for thumb keyboard design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The traditional man-machine questions take relation between people and big yardstick products as research object. Differently, this research regards relation between mobile phone and man hand as the main object, and carries on deeper and basic studying to this physiological characteristic with thumb. This research takes the outstanding question, placement design in mobile phone keyboard, as the center, utilized observing and experiment to obtain the basic principle of placement design of mobile phone keyboard for the male. Utilize this principle, we can not only appraise on the placement of the cell-phone keyboard after designed, but also offer guidance on the initial stage of designing

articleTitle: Study on the evaluation system of instrument cluster
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Ergonomic evaluation of industrial design products is inevitably requested because of the extensive use of ergonomics in industrial design. The appraise frame of the system and the mathematics model are built by the divide layers of fuzzy appraisal algorithms. The method of investigating and recognizing is used to attain the membership function and weight of each factor vector. The first class of factor vector including gauge shape, alignment method and so on is built, according to man-machine interactive access of fascia; then the second class of factor vector including appearance dial, character list, point needle, the color matches etc. Microsoft Visual C++6.0 is used to evaluate the system of the car instrument panel design

articleTitle: The ontology construction and data mining research of PDM system
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: To carry out the share of product data between different PDM (product data management) systems, this paper provides a domain ontology model of PDM system which is based on ontology and constructed by Protege3.1. This model consults the framework of PDM system in STEP PDM schema, uses the UML class figure to describe the relationship between the system classes. Finally by data mining the mass data of PDM, ontology libraries can be fully exploited and used, information and knowledge can be acquired for analyze and decision-making of enterprise

articleTitle: The research of an intelligent braking control system
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Applies the self-optimizing control to the control strategy of anti-lock braking system (ABS) and adds the braking pressure feedback to the system. The slipping rate change is thus controlled by way of controlling wheel speed and the double circuit of braking pressure. Simulation results prove that the approach to control is not only simple in algorithm but also able to recognize automatically the road surface change so as to provide the most suitable braking torque that serves the function intellectual braking. The shortcomings of conventional of logical thresholds, which were not based on systematic theories but on empirical trial and could not readjust quickly to respond to the change in road surface, are therefore overcome. The self-optimizing control is importance to improving the braking of various cars to ensure their driving safety

articleTitle: Desktop virtual assembly system based on PC
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Virtual assembly (VA), one of key technologies in advanced manufacturing field, is a promising application of virtual reality in design and manufacturing field. It has drawn much attention from industries and research institutes. In this paper, through the analysis to the theory of virtual assembly, with the aid of Pro/E to establish models and transform models into the form of VMRL form, we design a three-dimensional interactive virtual assembly system, making full use of Java language, EAI (external authoring interface) provided by VRML2.0 and script node of VRML. According to the principle of volumetric 3-dimensions display, we realized the stereoscopic displays in virtual assembly environment, which enables this assembly system to have good immersive feels, and realized the application of virtual assembly to the mechanical product design based on VRML and Java. Finally, an application example is introduced to testify the feasibility of the virtual assembly system prototype

articleTitle: Resources integration based onweb service and multi-agent in regional networked manufacturing system
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Resources integration is a key and difficult problem in networked manufacturing system. The trait of the resources and the importance and necessity of resources integration in networked manufacturing system are analyzed, and the difficulty for resources integration is proposed. Many traditional methods for resources integration are introduced, such as COM, DCOM, CORBA and JavaBean, and so on, and the defaults of these methods for resources integration are discussed. A three-layered approach based on Web service and multi-agent technology for resource integration is presented according to the investigation and the real require form the enterprise in the Chengdu-Deyang-Mianyang regional networked manufacturing system. Finally, the prototype system for resources integration is established and its running interfaces are shown to demonstrate the approach is feasible and efficient

articleTitle: Modeling of virtual traffic environment for driving simulator
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Viewing scene system is an important component for driving simulator. Its authenticity can give user sense of reality and immersion. Aiming at overcoming the shortcomings of the previous virtual traffic environment model, a new method is presented in this paper, i.e. using software 3dsMAX to construct 3D entity, then transform to 0.3ds format and import to Eon Studio for simulation. The finished virtual traffic environment model not only includes different kinds of road, such as road of city, road of mountain, road of village, but also can reflect time change a day and variation of weather. Far scene and close-by scene in the model can give driver a distinct vision sense. Furthermore, the virtual vehicles have dynamic intelligent behavior. Finally, this virtual traffic environment was applied to the autonomous virtual vehicle vision perception behavior system (AW-VPB System) for simulation test. The result was satisfying and proved that the virtual traffic environment can provide a better viewing scene for driving simulator

articleTitle: A new dual-mode blind equalization based on estimated error variance
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: A blind equalization algorithm may switch to a decision-directed (DD) equalization mode in order to speed up the convergence rate and improve the steady-state performance. The crux for this kind of equalization is the control of the switches between the two equalization mode. A new blind equalization scheme is proposed which automatically controls the switches between the blind equalization mode and DD equalization mode according to the estimated error variance, and the blind equalization mode used in the proposed scheme is the modified constant modulus algorithm. Simulation results shows that the proposed blind equalization scheme can present significant improvements in the convergence rates along with steady-state performance

articleTitle: Design symbol in culture context
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Design symbol has the fatal meaning to the design works. This paper expatiates the design symbol in the context of culture, demonstrates the emotional experience inspired by design symbols. As one part of culture code system, design symbol system makes its role in keeping and developing the culture. As the medium between people and design works, design symbols excite the affective resonance. In the encoding and decoding process, design symbol is the integrant portion

articleTitle: Research on hysteresis nonlinearity of GMA based on Preisach modified model
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Hysteresis nonlinearity of giant magnetostrictive material (GMM) makes it difficult to control giant magnetostrictive actuator (GMA), which has serious influence on the positioning precision of GMA. In order to describe and simulate the hysteresis characteristic of GMA exactly, the classical Preisach operator was modified and the discretization model was given in this paper. A prototype of GMA and the measurement system were designed, and the major hysteresis loop of GMA and the first order reversal curves were measured exactly. The parameter table of Preisach model was built based on the experimental data, then the hysteresis Preisach modified model of GMA was presented. The experimental results were close to model-simulating results with a max deviation of 0.4 mum, which indicates that the hysteresis model built was exact

articleTitle: An architecture template based SoC transaction level modeling and simulation method
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper presents a novel architecture template-based transaction-level modeling and simulation technique to support the fast exploration of on-chip architectures. System level design issues become critical with the increasingly complex integrated circuits and the time-to-market pressure continues relentlessly. Design reuse and early design decision for architecture such as function, communication, scheduling are a "must". Our technique is based on a transaction level architecture template exploration methodology in which a co-simulation of function, communication, scheduling is performed with the architecture described in an abstract manner. The template acts between system level task model and RTL cycle-accurate model, which can reduce the difficulty of mapping the system level task to RTL architecture directly. Architecture template-based transaction level simulation can tradeoff the speed and accuracy of simulation, Which can solve the problem that system level simulation is not accuracy enough and RTL simulation is not fast. A JPEG case study indicates that our exploration technique achieves simulation speedup and supports complete system simulation

articleTitle: Pivotal techniques of embedded software testing case generation by genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In software testing, it is often desirable to find test inputs that exercise specific program features. To find these inputs by hand is extremely time-consuming, especially when the software is complex. Therefore, numerous attempts have been made to automate the process. Often, the desired inputs must satisfy complex constraints, and this makes a random approach seem unlikely to succeed. We advance a visible arithmetic - GA (genetic algorithms) to solve this problem that how to generate efficiency testing case of embedded software for the designation path is covered with, because the key of automatic of software testing is the generation of efficiency testing case. In this paper, we discuss experiments with test generation problem that is harder than the ones discussed in earlier literature - we use a lager embedded program and more complex test adequacy criteria. In the last, we give "embedded software case generation system", which generate test case automatically for given embedded program unit. We discussed some technical details of this system. So we find a better technique based on genetic algorithms for automatic generation of testing case in embedded software

articleTitle: Research on Mini-Lathe conceptual design deduction based on fuzzy judgement
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on the machine product conceptual design of function layer analysis, this paper researches on fuzzy judgement about mini-lathe's design. Different from usual fuzzy judgement method in conceptual design, this paper introduces fuzzy judgement algorithm during the whole conceptual design, which is from the initial principle solution to final optimized solution. Mini-lathe is the foundation to build up desktop mini-factory, its design is different from ordinary one. This paper describes and illustrates the thought and arithmetic of mini-lathe conceptual design based on fuzzy judgement in detail. The method is practical and feasible to solve the problem that quantity of operation is over huge during the conceptual design

articleTitle: A mixed strategy for controlling movements of digital humans for automotive ergonomic design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on the marking and hierarchy of movements of digital humans and its skeletal subsystems and with help of the algorithm of transformation of objects in space, the movement chains of digital humans are analyzed. The movement control methods with forward and inverse kinematics for digital humans are discussed with emphasis, and the processes of controlling and realizing of these two methods with the algorithm are elaborated. For the specific purpose of digital human in automotive ergonomic design, a mixed strategy and process for controlling movements of digital humans, which employs both forward kinematics and inverse kinematics for different chain parts of a complex chain, is put forth and used in controlling the complex chains in digital humans to improve the manipulability and effectiveness

articleTitle: Research on humanization in bicycle design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Humanization is a dynamic concept with rich content. According to Marlow's the hierarchy of needs theory, we can generalize the features of humanization designing (HD) into two points: hierarchy theory and individuality theory. This paper takes bicycle as cut-in point to discuss about the humanization in bicycle designing over a period of more than 50 years back to the founding of China. Bicycle experienced a bouncing development in China; in the early period (40 years age), it's rather slow with a humanization designing at a lower material level; during the recent ten years, its development boomed fast with the humanization designing as the mainstream over one night, showing a colorful individuation feature that highlight humanization of bicycles

articleTitle: Study on perceptual evaluation of mobile phones form
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: To design a good product, it's essential that the product not only satisfies the function needs, but also grasps the consumer's psychological estimation. For some functional products such as car and mobile phone, the form is the key element to decide consumer's actions. Based on the kansei engineering principle, exemplifying a case of mobile phone, this paper describes the mobile phone form element categorizing as static element and dynamic element. A perceptual evaluation model for mobile phone was built through the data analysis using theory I of quantification which is of common use in psychology. Eventually, the mobile phones sales data in Shaanxi are used to test the evaluation model
