articleTitle: Study of the location awareness in bitTorrent-like networks
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper presents a new location-aware problem in BitTorrent-like P2P file transmission process, which has never been proposed clearly. The problem limits greatly the performance of P2P and consumes too many resources of the infrastructure. We present an ideal location-aware multi-source file transmission protocol and ameliorate the file transmission process. Then we design a project for the sake of improving the performance on location-aware BT-like network and reducing the cost of network operators without disturbing the downloading speed of peers

articleTitle: The man-machine fitness design research of modern class sorting system
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Fitness design fundamental research in the thing class sorting system, is one kind of person's factor consideration standardized method for the purpose of proposing. This article as an example of Pu Tian sorting system from the man-machine work criterion fitness, the man-machine work rhythm fitness, the man-machine working pattern fitness, the man-machine work mood fitness, four aspects carried on the analysis. By it, we took the basis reasonable man-machine function assignment and the thing flowed equipment development design, to obtain the highest comprehensive potency of system

articleTitle: Mapping the semantics of IA-64 simd instructions in binary reverse engineering
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The new features of IA-64 SIMD instructions make it difficult to map the semantics of machine instructions to higher-level intermediate representations, which is the key problem to binary reverse engineering. This paper presents an effective approach to semantic mapping of IA-64 SIMD instructions, improving existing technologies in two aspects. Our techniques extend the syntax of existing SSL according to the new features of IA-64 architecture and add new algorithms to meet the demand of mapping the semantics of some complicated SIMD instructions. Finally, the relevant techniques are evaluated by a set of programs from the Berkeley multimedia workload with a static binary translator from IA-64 to Alpha. The preliminary results show the originality and effectiveness of the approach

articleTitle: State-of-art of delay testing
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper overviews the research work on delay testing, focusing on the diagnosis of delay testing and fault set compaction, and approaches to delay testing are analyzed, pros and cons of each method is discussed, the future efforts of researchers are pointed out

articleTitle: Design and optimization of hydraulic bumper of large caliber sniper rifle based on cubic spline
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: To solve the problem of hydraulic bumper of a type of large-caliber sniper rifle that its flow gap area can not be adjusted, this article improved its structure with the help of computer. The flow area of hydraulic bumper was redesigned to be a groove which has variable depth. The outline of the groove was created by cubic spline. A set of optimized parameters were got by using the optimization toolbox of MATLAB. After improvement, the peak value of kick of the rifle descends by 54% and the kick changes more smoothly

articleTitle: Product form innovative design technology based on combination principle
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This article integrates conceptual design methods and product form design, search for the link between innovative design and product form design process and put forward a form innovative design technique which is based on combination principle. It has found two expressing models of product form, partitions those models and combining them implements form innovation

articleTitle: A product-form aesthetic evaluation system
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: An artificial neural network-based aesthetic evaluation system for product-form is presented in this paper. Fuzzy set theory and semantic difference (SD) method are applied to set up an aesthetic evaluation experiment, in which 400 product images were evaluated. First, a database of normalized images and quantitative aesthetic descriptions was constructed. Second, a back-propagation (BP) network model was constructed to learn the relationship between image spaces and quantified aesthetic words. Last, an intelligent evaluation system for product design was then developed based on the learned BP model. Applications demonstrated that the system evaluate product form-aesthetics accurately. Designers may promptly modify their design with the guidance of evaluation

articleTitle: Research and development of networked process planning system based on dynamic management of manufacturing resources
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the rapid development of computer science and network technology, information technologies have been applied widely to manufacturing procedure of products. Computer aided process planning (CAPP), as a bridge to connect CAD and CAM, has been playing a key role in advanced manufacture fields, such as computer integrated manufacturing, agile manufacturing, virtual manufacturing, enterprise resource planning and product data management. With information technologies' extensive popularization and their application in the information manufacturing, CAPP technology is gaining more and more attention. Being associated with the production manufacturing environment and following closely with the advanced development of CAPP technology, this paper systematically studies the architecture, implementing methodology and the key technique of networked CAPP systems based on dynamic management of manufacturing resource. Finally, a prototype system is implemented with relationship database technology, PowerBuilder, SQL Server etc. Its advantages, such as feasibility, reliability, practicability, friendly interface, maneuverability, have been verified

articleTitle: The studies of eye tracking and usability test
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the rapid development of computer science and information technology, the interaction between the human beings and computers developed increasingly. Researchers, designers and even consumers pay more and more attention to the usability of the HCI system. The eye tracking technology makes the test for the usability possible. This paper is based on the eye tracking studies on the interaction between human beings and computers, analyzing the problems that may emerge when the eye tracking technology is applied in the possibility test and posing some study-worthy problems by summarizing the past researches

articleTitle: Research of driving safety based on human body biological response
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Driving safety has always been an emphasis and difficulty in ergonomics interface design. In order to improve driving safety, this paper, which starts from the unsafe elements that human body may cause biologically, analyses perception fatigue and operation fatigue of human body from the perspectives of man-machine-environment, posture analysis, human body characteristics, then constructed the biomechanical human models which makes it possible to calculate human body parts by finite element method but realize human dynamic simulate. According to the biomechanical models, the ergonomic engine then computes the body stress distribution and physical loads of body parts such as upper extremity, hip, lumbar information during prolonged driving, then study intensively the change of biological characteristics parameters such as muscle fatigue and the effect on driver performance. In this manner, the biological response factor issues of human being can be effectively taken into account at the early stage of vehicle interiors layout design and can be used for passive preventive method. The half-rigid human models can also provide evidence for a designer at the early stage to improve the concept design of vehicle interiors

articleTitle: System-level co-design methodology based on platform design flow for system-on-chip
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Synthesis methods are important elements in platform-based design methodologies. This paper addresses platform-based design for system-on-chip (SoC). It takes hardware/software co-design and high level design reuse as keys to SoCs design. Particularly, it uses existing designs as starting points for new system implementations and put more stress on system level reuse. First, it introduces a system level co-exploration methodology and analyzes a typical platform-based design flow. Then it gives performance analysis and proposes a revised platform-based design flow. To support design technology innovations, several synthesis issues are discussed, such as platform reuse and configurable architecture. It also presents market-oriented views and introduces synthesis tools to support the co-design methodology

articleTitle: Sketching feature based vehicle design case retrieve in CBID system
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Design sketch reflect implicit insight, knowledge and expertise in vehicle styling. This paper focuses on a transformation of styling features situated in design sketches during the process of concept evolution, employs protocol analysis and behavior analysis, presents the model of vehicle styling macro-process, and applies it to a sketching feature based case retrieving module - draftmaker in CBID (case based industrial design) system

articleTitle: The analysis and research on the factors of sound annoyance in the operating environment
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: A-weighted level is the main method to evaluate the noise. The method of noise evaluation has some drawbacks because it can not include all kinds of sound and all factors which affects the work efficiency of operators. The sound includes music and song, language, the nature sound and noise, which have different effect on the work efficiency of operators. The factors effecting human annoyance include the kind of sound, special sound, A-weighted level, the different operating environment, the sound relationship with operators and so on. In the paper, the sound factors effecting human annoyance would be found and analyzed and their validity would be analyzed through some examples. Through these factors and their weights, the value of annoyance on some noise can be got which can be used to control the sound of operating environment and improve the work efficiency of operators

articleTitle: Concurrent tolerancing based on process factors and signal-noise ratio quality loss
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Modern manufacturing industries require balancing products' tolerances and manufacturing cost. In terms of different given process planning, there are always exist different process factors which correspond to different manufacturing cost. A number of papers have been published in the general area of tolerance models, but little work has been carried out for the research of process factors in tolerance allocation. In this paper, the relationships between process factors and manufacturing cost are investigated. In addition, signal-noise ratio (SNR) is employed to scale the quality loss of each machining process. Concurrent tolerancing optimization model based on process factors and SNR quality loss is then proposed. A practical example is also introduced to validate the presented method

articleTitle: Three-dimensional reconstruction of the human upper airway from computed tomography images
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: An accurate reconstruction of the human upper airway is necessary for modeling and analyzing the transport and deposition of inhaled aerosols. The major object of this paper is to rebuild a three-dimensional geometric model including nasal cavity, pharynx, larynx and trachea, which is used to research the effect of inhaled aerosols on the human upper airway. This geometric model is an anatomically realistic model which derives from three-dimensional computed tomography images scanning from the whole respiratory tract of a normal adult male with 0.75 mm intervals. With the CT data provided and using image and graphics recognition technologies, we reconstruct an accurate three-dimensional model of the human upper airway (STL file format) which can be directly used by computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulation of airflow and particle transport and laser rapid prototyping manufacture (LRPM) of respiratory tract model for the further experimental study

articleTitle: Analysis of vehicle's frontal crash based on structures' section forces
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, a new method of structures' section forces is used to analysis the vehicle's front crash. A complete finite element model of a passenger car is presented. According to the basic principle of the dynamic non-linear finite element method, the basic crash describe equation and FE discretized equation are established. The frontal crash of the integrated car system is successfully simulated in LS-DYNA and the results that including the structures' section forces and energy absorption time courses, the effect of the main energy-absorbing parts, the transmitting route of the energy and the forces change are attained. Simulation results show, the structures' section forces can accurately forecast not only crashworthiness of vehicles but also the way transmission of forces in crash process. This method provides an important tool to improve vehicle's structures' performances

articleTitle: Modeling and performance evaluation of network protocols
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the increasing complexity and shortening design cycles of embedded systems, system-level design methods are becoming more and more important. System-level design methods can determine whether the initial design alternative is feasible or not by the development of executable model of the system, which allows qualitative and quantitative properties to be analyzed before the system is actually realized in terms of hardware and software components. In this way, design errors can be detected in the earliest design phases. Furthermore, expensive and time-consuming design iterations are prevented. Network protocols have many complex concurrent and distributed characteristics, so it is very difficult to analyze them using mathematical methods. One of the most promising solutions to this problem is system-level modeling and simulation. This paper describes system-level design methods in detail. The modeling language Parallel Object-Oriented Specification Language (POOSL) and its extended component library are also introduced. Based on that, a system-level model for the selective-repeat sliding window protocol was built. Several results of performance evaluation are illustrated

articleTitle: Researching identity language of product family
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper presents the concept of the identity language of the product family which is composed of product personalities, style grammars and characteristic grammars. The generating method of the identity language is studied on the basis of expert evaluations and fuzzy probability expressions. One example is given to illustrate the proposed method

articleTitle: Real-time recognition of two-dimensional barcode based on ARM and DMA
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Two-dimensional barcode symbology is an emerging technology used for compactly storing and retrieving information. Accompanied with the development of the technology of 2D-barcode and speech coding, the dream of storing the speech on the paper has come true. Since the data capacity of speech 2D-barcode is large and must be decoded with the least delay, a high-performance, low-cost device is extremely needed in the decoding system. ARM (advanced RISC machines) microcontroller is widely used in many fields due to its characteristics of high-performance, small volume, low power dissipation and low-cost exactly. This paper proposes a novel implementation of real-time 2D-barcode recognition using ARM and DMA, which is an important technology used for high speed data transfer

articleTitle: Network securitymanagement based on data fusion technology
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the widespread application of large and complicated network, network safety has become an important issue. In this paper, a security operation center (SOC) concept based on multi-sensor data fusion technology is presented from the viewpoint of the network security. A structure of a SOC system based on radial basis function neural (RBFN) network is proposed, and the detailed method of data fusion in SOC is discussed. A prototype of SOC system is developed according to this structure of the SOC, experimental results indicate that the SOC system based on RBFN network can increase greatly the correctness of detection intrusion and decrease the rate of false positive

articleTitle: The recognition of character in license-plate image
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The recognition system of license-plate can improve the traffic situation. Sometimes the image of license-plate isn't clear, and some characters are difficult to identify. By image fusion, the clarity of license-plate can be improved. Because the ratio of standard character is unchanging, it is used to identify characters. First obtaining character from image of license-plate with segmentation technique, then match it with standard character. At last, characters can be identified. According to these ideas, a complete recognition system can be built

articleTitle: Surface detection with subvoxel accuracy using facet model and IDDG operator
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: A surface detection algorithm with subvoxel accuracy is presented to extract edge and surface information from computed tomography (CT) images for virtual measurement and reverse engineering. The proposed algorithm employs the facet model and 3D IDDG operator to estimate the gradient vector and 3D directional derivatives. Subvoxel accuracy is achieved by locating the zeros of the 3D second directional derivative along the estimated gradient direction. Adaptive gradient threshold is used for the surface detector to improve the algorithm performance when applied to images with non-uniform contrast caused by CT artifacts, such as beam-hardening. Experiment results are presented to demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed method

articleTitle: Applied research on conceptual design of product
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Thesis mainly discuss conceptual design (CD) and relation scheme of product development. For educing the problems in the process of product design, relation scheme and design relation model is educed by discussing the problem about exploitation of mechanical product and conceptual design, the problem of appose design, assistant creative exploitation and designer institute the scheme of creative exploitation by transferring existing examples in the process of product design are achieved by this scheme

articleTitle: Mathematical model for linear symmetry based on tolerancing principle
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Tolerance is defined by graphic example and text description in the national standard and is not adaptable for expressing, processing and transferring in computers. It is essential for the integration of CAD and CAM and how to interpret its semantics is becoming a focus. Research on tolerance of mathematical model has been the topic of active research in recent years. But the models seldom consider the tolerancing principle. Thus an improved mathematical model based on independence principle (IP) and maximum material requirement (MMR) was proposed for linear symmetry tolerance. Small displacement torsor (SDT) was introduced in tolerance modeling. The constraint conditions of linear symmetry tolerance were developed systematically under IP and MMR. The corresponding mathematical models of linear symmetry of surface feature and central feature were deduced. The models can interpret the semantics of symmetry tolerance exactly and completely and can be used with the following processing. It's very important applications for seamless integration of CAD and CAM

articleTitle: A new research of surfaces reconstruction of revolution in reverse engineering
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Current surface reconstruction algorithms focus on complex surfaces or irregular surfaces. However, surfaces of revolution are very important in industrial applications and reconstruction of rotating surfaces is often required. The most important step in surface reconstruction of revolution is to determine its axis. In this paper, iteration method is utilized to compute the central axis, which solves the problem of the shape identification of slice data. According to the defection difference of slice data, which will result in different shape, relative identification algorithms of circle and circular arc are proposed to recover the profiles. Different types of data are tested in our prototype system for reverse engineering. Experimental results show that the algorithm is practical and efficient

articleTitle: Mechanical product growth-design and soft-system developing
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on object-oriented technology and fully refer biology growth mechanism, starting with the most basal and nonobjective function of part and structure in product, abstracting its function feature, establishes the function structure which likes biology cell, so called cellular structure, defines the structure element of cellular structure which likes biology gene, so called gene element. Taking the demand of motion and forcing in product function, that is the flow of power (for short, power flow), as the thread, the whole product's mechanics capability as the target, ensures the product growth to optimize structure

articleTitle: Computer aided design system of cushioning materials
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The methods (C-sigma<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub> curve and Gm-sigma<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sub> curve) those are adopted from the Chinese standard GB8166-87 and used for the cushioning material design in voyage, architecture, automobile, transportation, and package fields have many shortcomings. The novel cushioning defense technique - energy absorption diagram method - were adapted to optimization design of cushioning materials in this paper. For this purpose, in the paper the demand, functions and modules of the computer aided design system of cushioning materials were analyzed. Then the system was designed particularly, and the energy-absorption-diagram production and optimization modules were mainly designed and realized. Finally some common examples on cushioning package design were computed in the final system, and the results from the final system and the methods in GB8166-87 were analyzed in contrast. The analysis and drop experiments on the designs according to the energy-absorption-diagram method proved that it is more reliable and efficient for this method to be used in the cushioning material optimization design than the methods in national standard GB8166-87

articleTitle: Brief discussion about the CAI class application in industrial design teaching
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Following with the 21st century's arriving, some modern technologies based on information are being applied more and more in the industrial design teaching domain currently, specially the using of the computer aided teaching CAI software, and it is gradually entering into classroom, enormously enhanced the teaching efficiency, it introduces the industrial design teaching to a brand-new boundary by manifestations with abundant bewrites and pictures, perfective acoustic images, concordant act and quiet, and by the extraordinary expressive force that can surmount the space and time

articleTitle: Research on the technologyand application of case-based product conceptual design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Product conceptual design is a problem-solving process which is an ill-structured domain in terms of the design knowledge. This paper depicts the process and pattern of product conceptual design adopting the case-based reasoning (CBR) method in a cognitive approach. The process of concept produced was examined in a design cognition experiment, using protocol analysis and sketch analysis. Two types of spontaneous use of CBR in product conceptual design: bottom-up processing and top-down processing were identified. And based on the two processing, a framework for concept formation with case-based design is presented to depict case-based product conceptual design, which includes descriptive model of case-based reasoning and interaction mode. On the basis of experiment and study, a case-based CAD product conceptual design system - CBID is developed

articleTitle: Some issues on the emotional design in urban residential landscape
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Compare to the stubborn pursuit of beautiful landscape and garden views in the residential sections, human's behavioral factors and sensation are by and large ignored at present. Particularly, the absence of identifiability, sense of belonging and human interests makes dull spaces. Thus the designs are rational but not considerate, which hardly make a strong feel of living and special community culture. Consequently, enhancing the environment cognition and promoting the social behavior in landscape design should be emphasized. The paper argues that, to build a rich and colorful living homestead and perform the humanistic principles deeply, the landscape needs reflect the peculiar local spirit and make abundant places for activities which agree with the residents' behavioral habits and mentality

articleTitle: Time characteristic analysis and circuit design of external interface of embedded system
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Citing the Ethernet and USB interface design of two microcontrollers, this paper emphasized the deeply analyzing and comparing of their external interface time characteristic, and presented the precise design scheme of interface circuit, and furthermore, discussed the universal ways and techniques of the external interface circuit design of embedded system

articleTitle: Research on distributed multi-screen display technique based on virtools
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Using distributed display technique, scene can be divided into several parts from different angle of view. When they project to different screens, the multi channel display effects can be achieved, and it is possible to simulate specified interactive virtual reality environment with high immersion. According to the specialty of virtual driving simulator, adopt the construction technique and components configuration technique of multi-screen display, and realize two kinds of projection screen system, CAVE and CYLINDER. Finally, a three channel virtual driving cab is developed by the technique mentioned above, and a high immersive virtual driving environment is founded, in which the liquid screens represent the windows of automobile. Comparing with related technology at home and abroad, the Studies have the features of good demonstration result, low cost and easy to use

articleTitle: Normal rectify algorithm study for realistic research in virtual assembly
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The paper researched visual realistic simulation focused on virtual assembly, and proposed a algorithm and theory of normal rectification, according to the feature of virtual assembly: after models are simplified, making use of Phong shading to build lighting-model through modifying and equilibrating normal. It can still make models more real in the status which has little detail and less facets, has been confirmed the usability and efficiency of the algorithms through realization of the system

articleTitle: Research on interactive virtual presentation technology based on WEB and CULT3D
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Due to the increasing demand of customer in variation and personalization of products, static, textual and 2D display of products are no longer satisfactory for presenting products on the Internet, especially for 3D digital products such as domestic electronics, industrial equipments and medical instruments. This paper aimed at the specialties of present network based on virtual display of 3D digital product, and put forward to a new Web3D technology - Cult3D, which advantages in contrast to VRML, are used to realize the virtual display and dynamic simulation in developing Internet 3D products. The research focused on some important problems such as the creation of digitization models and interactive dynamics simulation. The Application was proved that could help improve the effect of info transfer and customer satisfactory degree, provide a new interactive design mode for the development of new product, leading to a higher company competitive edge

articleTitle: Analysis and simulation of kinematic characteristic to 3PSS parallel robot mechanism
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: 3PSS parallel mechanism is one of the most utility outlook mechanisms among the parallel mechanism, but analysis and development to it is too inadequate. In this paper, analysis of the structure and degrees of freedom to it have been done, the inverse solution to the position analysis of the mechanism was solved by closed method and the forward solution to the position analysis was solved by numerical method. The singularity and the velocity of the mechanism were analyzed by Jacobian matrix, and the simulation of it was done, this established a good foundation for the determination of the work rule and the path-planning of 3PSS parallel mechanism

articleTitle: Research on value-driven framework for e-business
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The e-business needs the value-added-based completely online dynamic model and analysis framework including some processes from value-chain ontology-based modeling, value decomposition, analysis and reconstruction, value process modeling, value-driven inter-organizational workflow modeling, value-added e-negotiation analysis between value chain partners, interoperability and integration of value chain. It is base to implement business intelligence. This paper provides the formula patterns and analysis methods based-on value-driven modeling for e-business, and present the value-driven analytical framework for business intelligence. The important e-business model - e-marketplace is made for value-driven business analysis

articleTitle: The symbolization analysis of body vibration signal of diesel engine
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The author describe the actual state and the trend of diesel engine, as well as its predominance and characteristic comparing to gasoline engine. The acceleration signal of body vibration of 4135G diesel engine under different working condition are analyzed with symbol time series analysis. Forward-time and reverse-time symbol-sequence histograms are drawn and symbol statistics such as Shannon entropy and Euclidean norm are calculated by using symbolic time series analyzed method and by MATLAB, combining with the data of the acceleration signal of body vibration of 4135G diesel engine under different working condition, consequently we can discriminate the failure of 4135G diesel engine

articleTitle: Prosized product
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper probes into products and product designs on the basis of product semantics and hopes to clarify the categories of the semantic product designs as the way we use to separate written styles from each other. Because products naturally lack the ability to recount themselves, it cannot be compared with styles such as narrations and fictions. As a result, expository design, prosized design, poetic design and discussing design are available. This paper emphasizes the prosized design whose counterpart is prose that is one of written styles we are familiar with. Just like written language, these divisions are on the basis of different aims and emphasis on the conveyance of semantics. Although any distinctions seem mechanical, they define the directions and goals of designs and make designs more clear and pertinent. As to design teaching, this kind of division could enlighten students by these concepts of styles which they are more acquainted with and make them understand profoundly the specific features and functions of product semantics

articleTitle: Research on graphic rendering of grid data
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper both introduces the basic connect of digital elevator modal and analyzes the playground that DEM can play in GIS field. We implement a virtual 3D terrain rendering in a personal computer by using DEM data. When rendering the terrain, a quadtree-based optimization algorithm is used for generating continuous levels of a given terrain in real time. Both rendering quality and rendering speed is guaranteed. Besides, this paper also does some effort on the output quality and some basic function in a GIS system

articleTitle: The construction way of industrial design color tool based on Ostwald's color system
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The paper study the construction principle of Ostwald's color system according as color theory and knowledge of industrial design (ID), realize the visual model of Ostwald's color solid applying the OpenGL technology, then realize color's selection through the method of lower dimension display, at the same time, according to the theory of color harmony, build up the idiographic technology course to realize harmony, so assist user finish the color design quickly according to the harmony ruler of color system. Finally, the paper validated the tool's practice in the course of color design through the example of product color design

articleTitle: Chinese innovation calls for China's industrial design education
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Industrial designing (ID) is key to from "made in China" to "created in China". Industrial designing is the leading field to the innovative development of manufacturing industry. Today we are at the starting point of China's development of innovation. Facing with the transfer of global manufacturing center, with the upcoming era of "created in China", under the background of global economic integration, China should attach importance to the construction of some key sectors such as training for designing intelligence and technical innovation. Thereby the "made in China to created in China" which the Chinese government proposed can be done efficiently

articleTitle: The application of genetic algorism in multi-hierarchical complex mechanical structure scheme innovation design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, a kind of the creative design method that intelligently optimizes the hierarchical structure product has been studied and proposed based on genetic algorithms. Key technology about the improved genetic algorithms is applied to the multi-level complicated mechanical structure scheme design has been discussed based on many hierarchical structure describes, prevented the standard genetic algorithms from appearing the partial solution too early. A design instance with hierarchical mechanical structure is brought forward, laying a good foundation for the intelligent creative design of the hierarchical structure products

articleTitle: Design of an integrated production management mode for equipment manufacturing enterprises
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: To solve dynamic modification consistency of production plan and scheduling for equipment manufacturing enterprises, the integrated production mode combining CPM (critical path method), MRPII with JIT is presented. And connecting dynamic assignment and regulating mechanism restricted by the resources and time, a functional feedback model of multilayer production plan is constructed. A parallel production operational mechanism based on workflow management is advanced to guarantee product manufacturing flexibility and plan modification consistency. Finally, the model is proved reasonable and effective by structure design and realization of an integrated production management system executing in a locomotive enterprise

articleTitle: Enhanced multiple-view semantic feature modelling and feature conversion
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Current feature modelling systems suffer from a number of shortcomings. One is that the meaning of features is often not adequately maintained during modelling, which implies that modelling is in essence only geometric modelling. Another is that it is not possible to support product models with multiple feature views for all product development phases. This paper discusses solutions for these shortcomings. Semantic feature modelling is an approach to specify and maintain the meaning, or semantics, of each feature in a model. Enhanced multiple-view semantic feature modelling is an approach to support more product development phases. In the views, feature models can be used that contain high-level information. These approaches result in more meaningful product modelling, both in the sense of the models that are created, and in the sense of how these are created

articleTitle: The furniture design and research based on the concept of appeal
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The furniture is the essential companion of human's lives and works, and is the important constituent of indoor environment. In order to adapt to the needs of diverse aesthetic values, the appearance of modern furniture should pay great attention to the use of space, and should emphasize on the concept of appeal design. Like humanization design, the appeal design embodies more human concerns and the personalized design in a deeper level. The appeal design is also the important content of high appeal design that people pursue in our information age. In this paper, we explore the new trends of furniture design by researching the role of the concept of appeal in furniture design, anglicizing appeal design's content and characteristic, combining with the information age humanization design concepts

articleTitle: Discussion on the necessity of absorbing Chinese culture into Chinese design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Culture is a very important factor in affecting design and promoting its development, only by deeply rooted in culture could design make progress. The development of the Chinese design has to absorb Chinese culture into it. By analyzing the relationship between national culture and characteristics of design in different countries, and the relationship between Chinese culture and design, the current condition of the Chinese design, and the extensiveness of Chinese culture, the paper generalizes the great impacts and effects of Chinese culture on Chinese design. It also shows a way for Chinese design to referring to and integrating with Chinese culture to the Chinese design

articleTitle: Research of product symbol innovation based on context
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to present a new method for product symbol systemic analysis and product symbol innovation. Based on the elements of semiotics and product system theory, the studies analyze the essence and composing of product system and product symbol system, show context, as the most important dependence when product symbol system forms and transfers it's meanings and it is understood and accepted by users, containing operation context, scene context and society context. Based on the values of context, the studies present a new product symbol innovation method that includes society concept innovation, life style innovation and usage method innovation

articleTitle: Dynamic simulation and analysis of planetary transmission of ultra-precision planar polishing machine
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Planetary transmission of ultra-precision planar polishing has crucial effects on polishing path and quality. It studies the PE-1 style of ultra-precision double sided polishing machine. Combining with three-dimensional model in solidworks, the virtual prototype of the planetary transmission system is established based on ADAMS. The veracity of VP is validated by dynamic simulation. It analyses the relationships between the contact force changing and angular velocity. It provides advantage for further studies on mechanical polishing process

articleTitle: Simulation on dynamics of giant magnetostrictive actuator based on Matlab
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Giant magnetostrictive actuator (GMA) is a kind of new-generation actuator. The application of GMA is limited due to the inherent hysteresis and the nonlinearity. And the response speed can not achieve a satisfied effect. To solve the problem, the mathematical model of GMA was established in the paper. According to this model, a PID controller was designed and developed. The effect of the PID control can be seen at the end with the analysis of the results. The steady output and the response speed both have been enhanced

articleTitle: Improving minimum strain energy curve calculations for flexible blade cutting
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: A flexible blade cutting technique is applied for large physical prototypes. The flexible blade is heated and can shape thick layers of polystyrene foam. For tool path generation a numerical calculation model is available. In practice, the shape calculation time for the hot blade used in the flexible blade cutting process increases with approximately the 3rd power of the number of segments used in the blade model. For better accuracy of the blade shape representation a higher number of segments is required and this results in unacceptable calculation times. A changed procedure of blade shapes calculating has been implemented and tested. The method starts with a small number of segments and after shaping according to the minimum strain energy principle, all segments are subdivided in equal segments of half the length of the previous segments. The resulting blade shaping model is then the starting configuration for the next shaping calculation. This is done until the required number of segments or the requested representation accuracy is reached. A second improvement of the shape representation of the basic calculation method is also implemented, namely the angle setting segments (originally the first and last segments) are extended with two extra segments that fix the setting angles at the blade clamping location. This enables the blade to bend from the first up to the last segment. This provides a higher representation quality and enables more shape freedom resulting in a broader parameter space that can be used. Both enhancements of the blade shaping model provide are demonstrated with a few typical examples

articleTitle: Study on self-optimizing system of key parameters for complex machine products
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Modeling and FEA (finite element analysis) are required to be done over again after changing the key parameters. Thus, this paper constructs a distributed system which can change parameters of product, model and do FEA automatically. And it obtains the optimizing parameters at last. This system running on intranet bases on genetic algorithm and CATIA/CAA. Every client reads key parameters from the database in the server, drives the CATIA three-dimensional model by CATIA/CAA and the key parameters, and does FEA. After the result of FEA was sent to the database, the server evaluates the result of FEA and sends the evaluation to the database. Then, the server creates new key parameters using genetic algorithm; the system goes to next circle. The parameters, whose evaluation is the best, are the last result. Based on this system, the self-optimizing of key parameters for TBM (tunnel boring machine) is realized and accelerates the design process

articleTitle: Visual augmented reality interface for table-top e-business environment
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With rapid development of the Internet, diversified e-business models encourage changes in consumers' shopping behaviors. In existing e-business models, most of the Web sites only provide images and limited information of the products for the consumers. Provided only with virtual images, it is difficult for them to judge how the products will afterwards fit in the real environments. In this research, the authors have attempted to provide precise visual images and correct information of the products for the consumers. To achieve this goal, the authors have adopted augmented reality technology as a tool to develop a system which allows the virtual products adopted from Web sites to merge in consumers' actual home environment. In the developmental stage of the system, a desktop computer, a Web camera, location cards, and an interface in Web page form are incorporated to develop an interactive human/computer interface. This interface lets consumers augment the three-dimensional virtual artworks to a specified location of the actual environment. It also creates new shopping experiences for consumers

articleTitle: Comparison of shape ideation methods
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Shape ideation methods were inventored by observing subjects during a design contest. Data was generated in the form of photographs of sketches and mock-ups, interviews and diaries. The subjects had to redesign a housing of a computer-controlled phone call logger. All subjects used idea sketches, some used foam, clay, or CAD. From the CAD users, some made a physical model by milling or by stereo lithography. An evaluation panel selected the most attractive and the least attractive concepts. It appeared that the shape quality of the concepts did not so much depend on a particular shape ideation method that was used, but rather on the fact whether both physical and digital tools were used or not

articleTitle: Application of virtual technology in the exhibition - of virtual exhibition
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Exhibition industry is an emerging service industry. It plays an very important role in the aspects of economic restructuring, new markets exploitation, consumption advance, enhancement of cooperation and exchanges, expanding of products export, and promotion of socio-economic development. But with the limit of exhibition venues size, weather, traffic, time, cost and other factors, the development of exhibition industry confronts many obstacles. By analyzing the background, current situation and trend of virtual exhibition development, this thesis sets forth the superiority and function of virtual exhibition in the aspects of exhibition organizers, exhibitors and visitors. It proves the necessity of developing virtual exhibition. Also, it shows that developing virtual exhibition is the inevitable trend of exhibition development in the future. Virtual exhibition has broad application prospects, and it can complement each other with the traditional exhibition. They are expected to contribute to the development of exhibition industry

articleTitle: The ethical pondering upon design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Learned from the extensive range ethics, to consider the problem of design abroad from the angle of the ontology of aspect (including culture, esthetics, and ethics), the ontology of the design is the self-reflection on the existence of design itself, it's also the apperception and the explanation about the value and the meaning of design. The article tries to explain a series of problems from the angle of culture and philosophy, including definition, function, reformation, ethical values and design criticism. The article focuses on cultural research and philosophical criticism of the design activity thoroughly and intensively, which is also the springboard and thinking foundation of the article

articleTitle: On knowledge representation and intelligentanalysis of vibration isolation system
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In order to eliminate the disadvantage of traditional substructure mobility analysis method, a kind of object-oriented knowledge representation model of power flow in vibration isolation system is proposed in this paper. The model can deal with the static and dynamic knowledge of power flow in isolation analysis effectively. In the model, foundation, machine and floating raft are three types of the basic objects. By encapsulating isolators efficiently, the structured character and the expansibility of the system analysis and solution are improved. And the method is applied in the expert system for power flow analysis of vibration isolation system

articleTitle: Innovational design toward breakthrough products
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: If all the improvement of industrial design in the past are only on the base of styling and processing techniques, then in the new era, industrial design would shoulder an important responsibility to save products, innovative design would become the core product design. What are breakthrough products? Breakthrough products are reasonable combination of excellent shape and technologies, and can create value for the consumer user experience

articleTitle: A centralized optimization of dairy supply chain based on model predictive control strategy
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper describes a simulation method based on model predictive control strategy to find the optimal decision variables to maximize profit in dairy supply chains with multi-product, multi-echelon distribution networks and multi-product batch plants. The key features of this paper are: 1) inducts a model predictive control strategy under centralized management approach which is suitable for dairy supply chains founded by the key manufacture; 2) proposes a feasible and convenient simulation method with GAMS simulation tool that is able to solve the multiperiod MILP optimization problem and thus provide a strong support to supply chain managers in the decision-making process. A performance comparison between model predictive control strategy and common static optimization is made to prove the excellent effect of MPC strategy with both profits and customer service level more than doubled in an example problem, then the paper compares and analyzes the behavior of supply chains under centralized and decentralized management approaches and shows the former yields better overall performance in dairy supply chain management

articleTitle: Visual design study and implementation for 3 DOF parallel kinematic manipulator
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Traditional design of 3-DOF parallel kinematic manipulator is a serial design, in which physical prototype based design and verification bring about restrictions to the development period and efficiency. In order to realize rapidly and efficiently from the conceptual design step to prototyping step, it's proposed to combine VR with kinematics analysis, structure design and kinetic analysis to develop a visual design environment (VDE). Based on visualization of kinematic solutions the analysis results can fully account for kinematic behavior of the real machine. Moreover, the verification based on kinetic mode makes sure the design reasonable and reliable. Compared with traditional design our developed routines are very effective. In this paper the implementation is described in detail

articleTitle: Product identity system, the brand manager of enterprise
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper starts from the conception and source of product identity system (PIS), discusses the concept, contents, functions and composing of it. The PIS is made up of three parts: product basic system, product application system and product promotion system. Product basic system included logo & product sign, form of product, material & texture of product and product operating. And product application system included product specified color, graphics & patterns and visual elements three parts. Finally it discussed PIS handbook and the applicable areas of PIS

articleTitle: Development and research on the network design system of product package
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The product package collaborative design system which based on network was studied. The aim of the system design was to set a platform for the cooperative work among enterprises or between enterprise and clients, and enable the enterprise or clients to design through this system and work cooperatively Through this compositive collaborative product development platform and the communication serving mechanism, it can realize distance real time interaction and enhance the product development efficiency and the competing power of the enterprise

articleTitle: A hybrid immune intrusion detection system based on mobile agent
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Analyses were made on the security threats of present immune IDS schemes and the useful metaphor of biological immune system considering its application in the study of IDS. In light of the system flaws arising from the transfer of disease-causing mechanisms of biological immune system into IDS, a hybrid IDS scheme based on biological immunology and mobile agent was presented. The scheme precludes the security problems by utilizing the useful metaphors of biological immunity and the prominent characteristics of mobile agent, and is characterized by parallel operating, stability, adaptability and robustness. Further detailed analyses also justify its brevity, security, high efficiency, and thus considerable improvement on system overheads regarding software and hardware application

articleTitle: Parameterized function unit library for methodology of integrating high level synthesis and floor plan
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Nowadays, in the domain of integrated circuit designing, delay and power on interconnect wires have been playing a dominant role in total performance of circuit. As a result, design closure problem comes out. To solve the problem, methodology of integrating high level synthesis and floorplanning becomes one of the focuses of recent researches. Function unit library is an important part of high level synthesis, so we have designed a special parameterized function unit library for integrating high level synthesis and floorplanning based on the traditional library. The new library has a special 4-level function unit model, contains more information of function unit, and is able to generate parameters for new function units

articleTitle: The study of conceptual design based on industrial design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: From the meaning of conceptual design based on industrial design, it has introduced its basic procedure and the characteristic, some commonly innovative tactics have summarized briefly. And it has described its future thrust and decisive factors. All of these have demonstrated as the theoretical foundation in order to make the enterprise, market and consumers to grasp the importance of conceptual design roundly

articleTitle: The insight on the role of animation techniques in production innovation
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Why productions are connected with animation and cartoon? An important reason is that the aim of the product design is to design and guide a new way of life, and that animation and cartoon are just good at displaying human lifestyles by telling the story. This kind of display is dynamic, virtual and dramatic. Through animation and cartoon art we can find a better presentation for making product innovative, seek more humane reasons for the extension of product design, and provide a better way of advertising the promotion of products

articleTitle: Virtual reality based intelligent vehicle modeling in driving SIMULATION system
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The driving intelligence of the virtual intelligent vehicle in the driving simulation system is crucial to the system's sense of reality and the reliability of the experiment. This paper focuses on the features and functionality of the virtual intelligent vehicle in driving simulation system. Intelligent vehicle should first distinguish the roadway network in order to drive correctly along a certain path. Then the intelligent vehicle should be able to obtain the traffic information efficiently and to execute the decision-making process to response to the changing driving environment. This paper describes a method to construct the virtual intelligent vehicle using database technology and the collision detection algorithm. The experiment result illustrates that the virtual intelligent vehicles in virtual traffic environment can simulate the human vision genuinely and exhibit human-like driving behavior. The virtual intelligent vehicle can still keep the correctness and the efficiency in a comparatively complex traffic environment, also the stability of the system is satisfied

articleTitle: Simulation methodology for fighter conceptual design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper presents the computer simulation methodology for complication system's conceptual design. The conceptual design of complication system, such as a fighter, is a multi-system and multi-discipline synthesis course. And it includes a lot of factors. Finding the main factor and modeling of the relation between the main factor and the other factors should be focused on in the design. Computer simulation is a good method to visualize these relations. Through the method, conceptual design of a complication system can be effectively done. As an example, the relation between the fighter's maneuver and radar working state and missile launch is modeled. Resulting from the model, a pilot-in-loop air combat simulation can be accomplished. Through the simulation, the factors affects fighter performance can be analyzed. The method has been successfully used in fighter conceptual design. So, it can also be used in other complication system's conceptual design

articleTitle: Application of maximum entropy in engineering structual optimization
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In this paper, we study the application of maximum entropy in engineering structural optimization, and give a detailed analysis on the optimization procedure, the example demonstrates that the algorithm of maximum entropy engineering structural optimization is more accurate and its convergence has been improved

articleTitle: Exploration for human factors in the design of coal-mine safety and rescue devices
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Recent years production accidents keep appearing in coal-mines of our country. The author analyzes different factors that may cause accident and comes to the conclusion that most of the accidents are related to human factors. Among coal-mine equipments the safety and rescue devices have been responsible for protecting coal-miners against injuries and reducing economic loss of coal-mine corporation. But designers usually emphasis the technical performances and, in some degree, ignore the human factors in design of those devices. This situation has influenced use-efficiency and level of comfort of the devices when we use them. To improve the design of these devices, the designer should pay particular attention to human factors and interface design besides taking advanced technology

articleTitle: Discussion on customer knowledge management of modern manufacturing enterprises
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Customer knowledge management is the new phase of customer relationship management. By analyzing the customer knowledge, the paper clarifies the meanings and importance of customer knowledge management in modern manufacturing enterprises, describes the main contents and the management flow process of customer knowledge management, proposes several rules with which the customer knowledge management system is carried into execution. At last, some new problems to be solved in customer knowledge management are put forward

articleTitle: Real-time cooperative design based on UG software
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Aim at the actuality of badly lag of directive data transmission, badly reality of VRML format transmission, and incapable of modification to concretely structure, this paper develops quadratic exploitation based on Unigraphics soft through UG/Open API, makes it into realism when someone in cooperative net have forwardly modified the materials structure, then the operate instruction which has made on structure be transmitted to the other computer, so the materials structure in this computer can be automatically modified as in that computer, thus to make the real-time cooperation into reality

articleTitle: A universal Java interface to native 3D rendering platforms using multiple scenegraph representations
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: There are many 3D formats used for displaying 3D objects and supporting interactivity, sophisticated lighting and cinematography, and media integration of geometry, text, images, sound, vector graphics and video. Some of these also permit access to virtual scenes on the Web, and many permit some sort of programmatic scripting of the scenes. A few of these are VRML, X3D, MPEG4 and a variety of game engine formats. For reasons of processing speed and availability of 3D libraries these formats are generally implemented in native C/C++ code. However, these languages may not be the most elegant languages to use for artificially intelligent control of 3D for dramatic narrative, believable speaking characters, dynamic cinematography and stage management. A good alternative is the Java language which provides very productive syntax and a body of developed application code for control and management of 3D scenes. We first present an analysis of the problems of interfacing Java to 3D rendering systems, and some preliminary solutions in the context of interfacing Java to VRML. Finally we present a Java interface which is defined independent to the underlying 3D representation and format. This solution makes it possible to abstract out the particular field types used in the 3D rendering platform. Therefore a Java control system using the interface presented should be simple to port and integrate with any 3D rendering system using any 3D format

articleTitle: On optimizing image normalization algorithm for shape distortion
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In general, there are four basic forms of planar shape distortion caused by changes in viewer's location: rotation, scaling, translation and skewing. For a good shape descriptor should be invariant to these distortions, a shape can be normalized before feature extraction. Due to the problems of the normalization algorithm, called shape compacting, proposed by J. G. Leu, which cannot deal with rotation and skewing distortion thoroughly, this paper proposed an optimized image normalization method. The basic idea is to get the compact image first which is invariant to translation and scaling distortions by the shape compacting algorithm of Leu. In a second step, we find the main axis of the object shape and the angle between the x-axis, then rotate the image according to the angle. At last, we deal with the reversed object shape if possible by the sign of the original image's central moments. This algorithm can normalize a shape and it's distorted versions (rotated, scaled, translated, skewed) into a single result, so that they all become highly similar to each other. Therefore, the following feature descriptor will effectively be invariant to the above four distortions. Experimental results show that the improved algorithm is correct and effective, outperforms the existing shape compacting method

articleTitle: Study of testability design for complex electronic products
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: It mainly studies the testability design and analysis technology for complex electronic system for meeting the needs of design and product work and service work during using. It lucubrates testability design requests for the segments such as the partition for maintain level, the interface of test data, the interface of UUT and test equipments, during the processes of development, manufacturing and using, etc. The study is important to improve the testability level and realize integral test for electronic products

articleTitle: Research on the parameterization and remeshing technique application in surface reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In order to solve the problems that complex mesh needs a huge storage and high transmission price, and is difficult to be edited, simple algorithms are often required to obtain a series of object simulations. In this paper, three different parameterization algorithms are adopted to analyze their different effects on mesh quality after remeshing. Based on the parameterized mesh over a planar domain, subdivision algorithm is used to transform the mesh with arbitrary structure to a regular triangular or quadrilateral mesh. The algorithm in this paper aims at remeshing not only disk-like objects without holes but also closed objects, which using the concept of virtual boundary. The algorithm is proved practical and efficient in our prototype system

articleTitle: Research on collaborative management and design platform of processing equipment for network manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Based on the applicability of collaborative engineering and system engineering, a collaborative management and design platform based on collaborative management and design center was put forward, which was applied to solve collaborative management and design questions for enterprises. This platform system covered the key businesses such as conceptual model design, organization, resource and process control of the processing equipment collaboration alliance. The collaborative management of processing equipment design, organization, purchase-sale and resource has been achieved. Proceeding from the characteristics of the networked manufacturing, the mode, platform system architecture, characteristics and overall technological structures of the collaborative management platform were provided. Some key problems of the networked manufacturing collaboration alliance were solved, such as collaborative planning, collaborative design, and information exchange, etc. Finally, the modular fixture as the example of the processing equipment is used to check the feasibility of the design scheme

articleTitle: The research of computeraided ergonomics system framework based on the analysis of knowledge repository and man-machine system modeling
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The idea of computer aided ergonomics design (CAED) and its advantages over the traditional man-machine engineering design methods are presented. Two key problems of CAED system are explored: the building of the knowledge repository and the building of the model of man-machine-environment system. Based on these two cores, the framework of CAED system is proposed

articleTitle: Research of design processes of IA products based on usability
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In this post-PC era, there are many IA(information appliance)products entering into our daily lives. The way of use in these products might be very different from our past experiences. Use of a screen or a system is affected by a variety of factors. And the man-machine interface might be simulated virtually on the computer display rather than in physical buttons. Users are frustrated with many unusable products and have to deal with in their day-to-day lives. Offering customers 'user-friendly' products could be seen as something new in markets. Of the factors involved in the product creation process, usability issues can be amongst the most significant in terms of influencing the commercial success of the product. The interface is a communication tool between man-made machines and humans. One way to enhance the usability of IA products is to improve the appearance of the user interface. In this research, the author sought to propose an innovative product development process suitable for the post-PC era. Several user-interaction oriented processes of product development adopted by the industries were examined. The contents and procedures of user-interaction design then were further analyzed. Accordingly, an innovative operational approach of IA products design based on usability was proposed

articleTitle: Infringement of intellectual property rights of industrial design: multinationals' strategy, practice, and concerns in China
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Industrial design innovation can improve product's utility, make its quality and reliability perceptible, create an emotional and aesthetic bond with consumers, thus enhance a product's competitive position. By influencing the incentives to innovate, design rights protection is a significant determinant of industry growth. This paper examines how multinationals, mainly of the consumer electronics industry, protect their design rights in China. The focus is on how these multinationals proactively prevent infringement of their design rights, and how they react to design rights infringement under China's intellectual property protection system, along with other institutional and cultural characteristics. Multinationals' concerns and problems with design rights protection in China are also addressed. Our study suggests that design rights protection practiced by multinationals in China may shed some light for Chinese companies if they desire to reach larger markets, boarder technological resources and more business success

articleTitle: An online sketching and gesture editing system for conceptual design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The paper describes the development of an online sketching design and gesture editing system for conceptual design, named Sketch2D. The system uses sketches and gestures as the main interaction paradigm. First, the preprocessing methods of the single sketching stroke are presented including automatic segmentation, recognition and regularity. Then we design nine kinds of pen-based gestures which are used to edit the conceptual sketch. At last, the experimental results of three different training algorithms for gesture recognition are compared with each other such as pattern matching, Bayes classifier, BP neural network. Experiments show that the presented online sketching system can improve user adaptation and intelligence of current CAD systems
