articleTitle: Kinematic scheme design based on design catalogue
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: First of all the essential procedure of design catalogue is expatriated on. And the methods of function coding and mechanism coding are defined according to the features of function and mechanism. On this base, the function table and mechanism table including evaluation criteria are constructed. Then because different users have different interests in the importance of various evaluation criteria of function, a user's function table is set up to describe the user's function on one hand and the different authority of each evaluation criteria for different functions is acquired with AHP(analysis of hierarchy process) on the other hand. In addition the user's functions may be searched in mechanism solution table and the set of feasible solutions is obtained. At last the optimal solution is achieved with a fuzzy evaluation method. In terms of idea expressed above the software system kinematic based design catalogue is developed for kinematic design. Accordingly, a software system kinematic based on design catalogue is developed

articleTitle: Matching of multi-scale digital raster map using precise geometric correction
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In the processing and applying of the digital map, it is one of the key technologies that aligning the maps from different projective coordinate systems to a standard. Using the principium of geometric correction, the paper compared and analyzed three correction models of the raster map, presented the idea of correcting the maps of different scale with corresponsive correction models, and citing a map of certain scale, the author compared the correction effects and errors of three models by programming and proved the accuracy and feasibility of this idea

articleTitle: An improved approximate arc-length parameterization method for Bezier curves
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: We provide a method for approximate arc-length parameterization for Bezier curves by using the subdivision techniques and give the corresponding algorithm. By finding the so-called `worst point' of the curve and subdividing the curve at the corresponding parameter value, we got two Bezier curves. Let the two curves have weights that are proportional to their approximate arc-lengths. Then we repeatedly do the same to the newly generated Bezier curves and finally we can get a piecewise Bezier curve. By means of knot inserting technique we convert it into such a curve that has the B-spline form. Now this new curve has a global parameter and in the interval of which each Bezier curve will have a parameter sub-interval of length proportional to its weight. Thus we get a curve with approximate arc-length parameterization

articleTitle: Discussion on context participation in the process of expression conceiving and receiving
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Conceiving, expressing and receiving should be considered by the W-words $when and where. Both context factors with no doubt put impact on the subject and object of conceiving. That's why the expresser must choose the way of conceiving and expressing by context; and the receiver for the same reason must receive equivalently and increased; even revaluation can be done. It means the restriction of semantic scope, the complement of extra meanings of words and the tracking of a second time agreement. Borrowing ideas from the contextual concepts of rhetoric, pragmatics, considering the connections among conceiving, expressing and receiving, the final goal of communication can be achieved

articleTitle: Study on styling image and brand identity of vehicle based on mechanism constraints
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In order to obtain the most advantageous modeling feature sample to establish and maintain the brand identity, the effect of regular change based on mechanism constraints of vehicle hood side profile on styling image and brand identity was studied. The method used in this study was proved to be effective and it was believed to be the groundwork to empolder the computer aided product design system

articleTitle: Predicate removing technique in machine emulation for IA-64 aechitecture
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: EPIC (explicitly parallel instruction computing) architectures, such as the Intel IA-64 (Itanium), support novel features such as explicit instruction-level parallelism and predicated instructions. While these features promise to make code more efficient, the fact that these new architectural features means that EPIC code is more difficult to analyze than code for more traditional architectures. This paper describes a technique for removing predication instructions from optimized binary programs in a way that is guaranteed to preserve program semantics, thereby and thereby improve the quality of machine emulation for IA-64

articleTitle: Research on design culture of Chinese automobile modeling
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The modeling design of automobile involves a great many of aspects. The paper analysis the modeling of the "Chinese automobile" from the viewpoint of industrial design. The paper will through all kinds of inquisition data, withdrawing the design symbol of the "Chinese automobile" from the evolvement of the Chinese social culture, social construction, social condition, social psychology and the Chinese traditional plastic art, to analyze how modeling of the "Chinese automobile" is ability to contain national culture characteristic

articleTitle: A testbed of integration and collaboration for legacy single-user CAD applications
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This paper explores a testbed to add collaborative capabilities to single-user CAD applications. The testbed uses internal encapsulation and external encapsulation to wrapper legacy single-user CAD applications. The communication mechanism and experiments of encapsulation agent are studied. The basic issues for collaborative applications, such as consistency maintenance, group awareness and collaborative management, are discussed. The proposed method was implemented with case study of prototype tools to integrate both homogeneous and heterogeneous single-user application for collaborative application. In this way, the standalone CAD systems can integrated into network-based collaborative design environment

articleTitle: Creational design for traditional culture vision
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Chinese traditional culture with thousands of years of history, takes language, painting, music, character, architecture and so on as its external embodiments. Designing is also a kind of culture, while the unique Chinese calligraphy can represent our traditional culture more incisively and vividly. This paper takes Chinese calligraphy as the cut-in point, to discuss the usages of traditional recognizant-image in creational designing of modern products, by expatiating of symbolic characters and cultural attributes in Chinese calligraphy

articleTitle: The essence of design appears in the hairlike place - analyzing how to apply the design semeiology to product design in brief
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The article firstly analyses an excellent design works, which elicits the concept of design semeiology. And then it educes some principles which can be used in product design in the process of research about impressions of design hematology and the relations between design symbols and product design. The primary purpose of the thesis is to touch the essence of product design from a hairlike place of manufactures and to give designers a hand about how to utilize design symbol in the process of product design

articleTitle: The PowerBuilder design technology for the data window print preview and print
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: This science fund item come from the Education Office of Shaanxi Province, China (No. 04jc27). It was named "the manufacturing management information system base on the wireless network", by the item practice design for the enterprise network database of the BAOJI DEPARTMENT, THE JINSHAN ELECTRIC GROUP COMPANY. In this paper, we discuss the technology that uses the OO project method to make the PowerBuilder programming for the Data Window print preview & print

articleTitle: The exertion of market researching in early product design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: A company should have an all-around understanding about market and early product design researching appears so important that companies should orient the design basing on strict and dependable data and information with rational market research. If necessary, companies also need adjust the orientation in time according to the feedback of the market. This thesis just concerns about the research of early product designing orientation. With comparing the existed market researching methods in domestic market with those in foreign market, the author tries to seek for another suitable researching method tallying with the special early product design of China and analyses the feasibility of this researching method

articleTitle: Research on designers' product color perception of mobile phone
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Color plays an important role in product design and affects consumers' preference in purchase. This study investigated the designers' product color perception. The semantic differential (SD) method was employed to examine the mapping relationship between designer perception and design color. Taken the mobile phone color design as an example, the model of designer perception and color cognition was set up so as to improve product color design rationality and validity. The study of the designers' product color perception assists the designers in color design. And it is necessary to study designers' color perceptual image and find out the color attributes and meaning for color design

articleTitle: A pure distributed framework for large-scale microscopic traffic simulation
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Microscopic traffic simulation is effective for analyzing transportation networks, and distributed simulation modeling is the optimal approach for the simulation. In this paper, a pure distributed modeling framework (called DMTSS) for large-scale traffic simulation is proposed. DMTSS consists of low-cost PCs networked by high-speed local area network, the heavy computational task is divided into multiple light subtasks according to transportation subnets, and subtasks are distributed to these PCs. A distributed database is used to hold necessary data, and a distributed synchronization mechanism is employed to improve the efficiency of synchronization. To ensure the system stably running for long time, the failure recovery scheme is presented to recover the system from error state. Implemented details such as communication and are also discussed. Analyses indicate that the proposed framework is scalable and reliable and effective

articleTitle: Experience design in the City Creating Industry growth opportunities and challenges for Design Industry
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Many people think that an age of "creating industry" would follow an age of "computer information" as the next economy stage. This has happened. It seems that something is better with "creating industry" around the Chinese cities from Beijing to Shanghai, because "creating industry" could be made commodity by experience design. Moreover, the experience design is now playing the more important role of the city creating industry, and to be new opportunities and challenges for China designer and design industry

articleTitle: Distributed web geographic information system application based on component
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Geographic information system (GIS) has developed at very high speed in recent years. With the development of computer technique, especially distributed component technique, Web GIS has made rapid progress. Based on these existing popular technologies, this paper presents a distributed Web GIS application based on component technology. It presents the basic framework of the proposed system at first, and then discusses the key technology of implementing this system; finally it designs a three-layer Web GIS instance using VC++ ATL based on Geo Beans. The example suggests the proposed design is correct, feasible and valid

articleTitle: Design and realization of case-based reasoning product conceptual design system
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The conceptual design process of product is an important, complicated, active, and creative phase in the product design process. Case-based reasoning technology provides a high-effective computer-aided design method for conceptual design. The paper provides an applied and creative product conceptual design method that embodies the industrial design knowledge (including form, style, color, human-factor, sculpt etc.). It has been used into the conceptual design system successfully. And the system abbreviates the conceptual design process, helps the designers, and provides a base for the following development of product

articleTitle: The individualized design of products
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: With the fast development of era and the constant progress of social civilization, promoting the fast transition of thinking ideas of people greatly, people become self-respected and pursue individual character life more and more, this makes future product design move towards the pluralism and individualized trend. The individualized products can cater to people's taste even more and possess stronger commercial competition on the basis of respecting science and rational, the individualized design of the products would be promoted greatly too

articleTitle: The idea of primordium in the virtual packaging design
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The idea of primordium in the packaging design is a kind of sincere creation going back to life. It is presented in the information society that can certainly enable the modern virtual packaging design to have the longtime vitality and the continuous nature

articleTitle: Design and application on slice server of visual human
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: The concept about slice server of visual human will be studied and applied in 3D-human dataset (which is applied in 3D-reconstruction of human skull and facial blood vessel in this paper). Based on this foundation, we bring forward the thoughts about the computer slice server model and found the basic framework. Further more, we resolved the problem about the location, extraction and displaying of slices and develop the prototype system applying with our dataset by the tools - OpenGL

articleTitle: Grafted genetic algorithm and its application
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Genetic algorithm has found its application in various engineering areas, but it has the limitation of premature convergence and exhausting computing amount when applied in the job-shop scheduling problems. Aiming at these limitations, a new hybrid genetic algorithm called grafted genetic algorithm (GGA) is developed for job-shop scheduling problem. The introductions of grafted population and crossover probability matrix enhance the ability of the GGA to accelerate the evolvement and to fight premature convergence. Finally, the effectiveness and high efficiency are illustrated with the 6 classic examples

articleTitle: A component library for IP core based system level design automation
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Resent years, IP reuse has become a key factor for SoC design productivity improvement. A standard component library with a certain scale is crucial to the whole process of IP reuse. In this paper, we present a complete design and implementation of a component library which supports the system level design automation. The main contribution of this paper contains two aspects: first, it establishes the data structure for the reusable component, and the data structure contains the data needed in system level design; second, it describes the design and realization of the tool to manage the component library

articleTitle: Estimating principal deformable freeform features by curvature analysis
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: A suitable estimation of the initial positions, orientations and dimensions of a template referring to a freeform feature in an existing geometry is a prerequisite for template fitting and template based shape reconstruction and manipulation. In this paper, a curvature analysis based method is proposed to estimate the principal freeform feature in a specified region of interest for template fitting. Based on the minimal, maximal, mean or Gaussian curvature computing, the geometric information is transferred to the curvature domain. Using a variant of Laplacian smoothing methods, the high frequency noises and interferences in the curvature domain are suppressed and the principal feature is addressed. By feeding back the extracted feature information to the geometric shape, the geometry of the template is estimated based on the feature analysis. With several case studies, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified. Different effects caused by different curvature computing methods are discussed as well

articleTitle: A novel conceptual design for MIMO handset
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: In the future, the mobile communications system will transmit high speed data by MIMO technology. This article analyzes the MIMO-terminal-design technology from the view of ergonomics, and brings forward a new design conception to set more antennas on handset. This design enlarges the antenna-installation-areas and extends the area from the top to the sides. Compared with traditional design, it can fit more antennas in MIMO handset, and can decrease shelter effects by hand. At the same time, it can provide fashionable shape and comfortable holding sense for users

articleTitle: Intersymbol competition: research on strategy deoxidization and design orientation of product language
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: At the view of the adaptive mechanism of Simon, this paper regards product as the artificial (an adaptive mechanism), to analyze the relationship among product language (the interior environment), SET factors (the exterior environment) and design strategy (the interface). From the analyses of synchronic factors such as form, color, material, technology and diachronic factors such as operational context, social linguistic context, context of genesis and ecological context of product language, we can find the clear corresponding relationship between product language and design strategy. At one time, from the analyses of SET factors we find that previous product, brand image, style of other competitors and target users' understanding and cognizing of product language are most relative exterior factors. According to these and with the bridge of design strategy the author has established the analyzing frame from SET factors to design language. Finally, this paper establishes an adaptive mechanism model of product group including both strategy deoxidization and design orientation of product language

articleTitle: Touch and design (T'ND) a European funded project
publicationTitle: 2006 7th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design and Conceptual Design
abstract: Gestures, besides speech, represent the mostly used means of expression by humans. For that regards the product design field, designers have multiple ways for communicating their ideas and concepts. One of them concerns the model making activity, where designers make explicit their concepts by using some appropriate tools and specific hand movements on plastic material with the intent of obtaining a shape. Some studies have demonstrated that visual, tactile and kinesthetic feedbacks are equally important in the shape creation and evaluation process. Moreover current computer aided tools aimed at supporting the conceptual phase of product design are not intuitive to use, and do not exploit designers' skill and creativity. This paper presents the results of a research work aiming at integrating user-friendly and effective ways of interaction based on ad-hoc haptic interfaces into free-form shape modeling systems. The European project "Touch and Design" (T'nD) proposes the implementation of an innovative virtual clay modeling system based on novel haptic interaction modality oriented to industrial designers. In order to develop an intuitive and easy-to-use system, a study of designers' hand modeling activities has been carried out by the project industrial partners supported by cognitive psychologists. The users' manual operators and tools have been translated into corresponding haptic tools and multimodal interaction modalities in the virtual free-form shape modeling system. The paper presents the project research activities, the results achieved so far and the future related work
